Path where Highcharts will look for export module dependencies to
load on demand if they don't already exist on `window`. Should currently
point to location of [CanVG](https://github.com/canvg/canvg) library,
[jsPDF](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) and
[svg2pdf.js](https://github.com/yWorks/svg2pdf.js), required for client
side export in certain browsers.

Note: Highcharts cannot take responsibility for the security of any
external libraries (including [optional dependencies](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/getting-started/optional-dependencies))
loaded through `exporting.libURL`. These libraries are not licensed or
warrantied under the Highcharts license.
Since v13, this option has no default and must be configured explicitly.
To load dependencies from the Highcharts CDN, set it to
`https://code.highcharts.com/{version}/lib/`.

name: exporting-local
title: local
description:
Whether the chart should be exported using the browser's built-in
capabilities, allowing offline exports without requiring access to the
Highcharts export server, or sent directly to the export server for
processing and downloading.

This option is different from `exporting.fallbackToExportServer`, which
controls whether the export server should be used as a fallback only if
the local export fails. In contrast, `exporting.local` explicitly defines
which export method to use.

name: exporting-menuItemDefinitions
title: menuItemDefinitions
description:
An object consisting of definitions for the menu items in the context
menu. Each key value pair has a `key` that is referenced in the
[menuItems](#exporting.buttons.contextButton.menuItems) setting,
and a `value`, which is an object with the following properties:

- **onclick:** The click handler for the menu item

- **text:** The text for the menu item

- **textKey:** If internationalization is required, the key to a language
  string

Custom text for the "exitFullScreen" can be set only in lang options
(it is not a separate button).

name: exporting-pdfFont
title: pdfFont
description:
Settings for a custom font for the exported PDF, when using the
`offline-exporting` module. This is used for languages containing
non-ASCII characters, like Chinese, Russian, Japanese etc.

As described in the [jsPDF
docs](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF#use-of-unicode-characters--utf-8),
the 14 standard fonts in PDF are limited to the ASCII-codepage.
Therefore, in order to support other text in the exported PDF, one or
more TTF font files have to be passed on to the exporting module.

See more in [the
docs](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/export-module/client-side-export).

name: exporting-pdfFont-bold
title: bold
description: The TTF font file for bold text.

name: exporting-pdfFont-bolditalic
title: bolditalic
description: The TTF font file for bold and italic text.

name: exporting-pdfFont-italic
title: italic
description: The TTF font file for italic text.

name: exporting-pdfFont-normal
title: normal
description:
The TTF font file for normal `font-style`. If font variations like
`bold` or `italic` are not defined, the `normal` font will be used
for those too.

name: exporting-printMaxWidth
title: printMaxWidth
description:
When printing the chart from the menu item in the burger menu, if
the on-screen chart exceeds this width, it is resized. After printing
or cancelled, it is restored. The default width makes the chart
fit into typical paper format. Note that this does not affect the
chart when printing the web page as a whole.

name: exporting-scale
title: scale
description:
Defines the scale or zoom factor for the exported image compared
to the on-screen display. While for instance a 600px wide chart
may look good on a website, it will look bad in print. The default
scale of 2 makes this chart export to a 1200px PNG or JPG.

name: exporting-showExportInProgress
title: showExportInProgress
description:
Display a message when export is in progress. Uses
[Chart.showLoading()](/class-reference/Highcharts.Chart#showLoading).

The message can be altered by changing
[lang.exportInProgress](#lang.exportInProgress).

name: exporting-showTable
title: showTable
description: Show a HTML table below the chart with the chart's current data.

name: exporting-sourceHeight
title: sourceHeight
description: Analogous to [sourceWidth](#exporting.sourceWidth).

name: exporting-sourceWidth
title: sourceWidth
description:
The width of the original chart when exported, unless an explicit
[chart.width](#chart.width) is set, or a pixel width is set on the
container. The width exported raster image is then multiplied by
[scale](#exporting.scale).

name: exporting-tableCaption
title: tableCaption
description:
Caption for the data table. Same as chart title by default. Set to
`false` to disable.

name: exporting-type
title: type
description:
Default MIME type for exporting if `chart.exportChart()` is called
without specifying a `type` option. Possible values are `image/png`,
 `image/jpeg`, `application/pdf` and `image/svg+xml`.

name: exporting-url
title: url
description:
The URL for the server module converting the SVG string to an image
format. By default this points to Highcharts free web service.

name: exporting-useMultiLevelHeaders
title: useMultiLevelHeaders
description:
Use multi level headers in data table. If [csv.columnHeaderFormatter](#exporting.csv.columnHeaderFormatter) is defined, it has to return
objects in order for multi level headers to work.

name: exporting-useRowspanHeaders
title: useRowspanHeaders
description:
If using multi level table headers, use rowspans for headers that
have only one level.

name: exporting-width
title: width
description:
The pixel width of charts exported to PNG or JPG. As of Highcharts
3.0, the default pixel width is a function of the [chart.width](#chart.width) or [exporting.sourceWidth](#exporting.sourceWidth) and the
[exporting.scale](#exporting.scale).

name: global
title: global

name: global-buttonTheme
title: buttonTheme
description:
General theme for buttons. This applies to the zoom button, exporting
context menu, map navigation, range selector buttons and custom
buttons generated using the `SVGRenderer.button` function. However,
each of these may be overridden with more specific options.

name: global-buttonTheme-fill
title: fill
description: The fill color for buttons

name: global-buttonTheme-padding
title: padding
description: The padding of buttons

name: global-buttonTheme-r
title: r
description: The border radius for buttons

name: global-buttonTheme-states
title: states
description: State overrides for the buttons

name: global-buttonTheme-states-disabled
title: disabled
description:
Disabled state overrides for the buttons are applied in
addition to the normal state options

name: global-buttonTheme-states-disabled-style
title: style
description: Disabled state CSS style overrides for the buttons' text

name: global-buttonTheme-states-hover
title: hover
description:
Hover state overrides for the buttons are applied in addition
to the normal state options

name: global-buttonTheme-states-select
title: select
description:
Select state overrides for the buttons are applied in
addition to the normal state options

name: global-buttonTheme-stroke
title: stroke
description: The stroke color for buttons

name: global-buttonTheme-stroke-width
title: stroke-width
description: The stroke width for buttons

name: global-buttonTheme-style
title: style
description: CSS styling for the buttons' text

name: lang
title: lang

name: lang-accessibility
title: accessibility
description:
Configure the accessibility strings in the chart. Requires the
[accessibility module](https://code.highcharts.com/modules/accessibility.js)
to be loaded. For a description of the module and information on its
features, see
[Highcharts Accessibility](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/accessibility).

The lang options use [Format Strings](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#format-strings)
with variables that are replaced at run time. These variables should be
used when available, to avoid duplicating text that is defined elsewhere.

For more dynamic control over the accessibility functionality, see
[accessibility.point.descriptionFormatter](#accessibility.point.descriptionFormatter),
[accessibility.series.descriptionFormatter](#accessibility.series.descriptionFormatter),
and
[accessibility.screenReaderSection.beforeChartFormatter](#accessibility.screenReaderSection.beforeChartFormatter).

name: lang-accessibility-announceNewData
title: announceNewData
description:
Default announcement for new data in charts. If addPoint or
addSeries is used, and only one series/point is added, the
`newPointAnnounce` and `newSeriesAnnounce` strings are used.
The `...Single` versions will be used if there is only one chart
on the page, and the `...Multiple` versions will be used if there
are multiple charts on the page. For all other new data events,
the `newDataAnnounce` string will be used.

name: lang-accessibility-axis
title: axis
description: Axis description format strings.

name: lang-accessibility-chartContainerLabel
title: chartContainerLabel
description:
Accessible label for the chart container HTML element.
`{title}` refers to the chart title.

name: lang-accessibility-chartTypes
title: chartTypes
description:
Chart type description strings. This is added to the chart
information region.

If there is only a single series type used in the chart, we use
the format string for the series type, or default if missing.
There is one format string for cases where there is only a single
series in the chart, and one for multiple series of the same
type.

name: lang-accessibility-credits
title: credits
description:
Accessible label for the chart credits.
`{creditsStr}` refers to the visual text in the credits.

name: lang-accessibility-defaultChartTitle
title: defaultChartTitle
description:
Default title of the chart for assistive technology, for charts
without a chart title.

name: lang-accessibility-drillUpButton
title: drillUpButton
description:
Accessible label for the drill-up button.
`{buttonText}` refers to the visual text on the button.

name: lang-accessibility-exporting
title: exporting
description: Exporting menu format strings for accessibility module.

name: lang-accessibility-graphicContainerLabel
title: graphicContainerLabel
description: Set a label on the container wrapping the SVG.

name: lang-accessibility-legend
title: legend
description: Language options for accessibility of the legend.

name: lang-accessibility-legend-legendItem
title: legendItem
description:
Accessible label for individual legend items. `{itemName}` refers
to the visual text in the legend for that item.

name: lang-accessibility-legend-legendLabel
title: legendLabel
description:
Accessible label for the legend, for charts where there is a
legend title defined. `{legendTitle}` refers to the visual text
in the legend title.

name: lang-accessibility-legend-legendLabelNoTitle
title: legendLabelNoTitle
description:
Accessible label for the legend, for charts where there is no
legend title defined.

name: lang-accessibility-navigator
title: navigator
description: Navigator language options for accessibility.

name: lang-accessibility-navigator-changeAnnouncement
title: changeAnnouncement
description:
Announcement for assistive technology when navigator values
are changed.

Receives `axisRangeDescription` and `chart` as context.
`axisRangeDescription` corresponds to the range description
defined in [lang.accessibility.axis](#lang.accessibility.axis)

name: lang-accessibility-navigator-groupLabel
title: groupLabel
description:
Label for the navigator region.

Receives `chart` as context.

name: lang-accessibility-navigator-handleLabel
title: handleLabel
description:
Label for the navigator handles.

Receives `handleIx` and `chart` as context.
`handleIx` refers to the index of the navigator handle.

name: lang-accessibility-rangeSelector
title: rangeSelector
description: Range selector language options for accessibility.

name: lang-accessibility-screenReaderSection
title: screenReaderSection
description:
Language options for the screen reader information sections added
before and after the charts.

name: lang-accessibility-screenReaderSection-annotations
title: annotations
description: Language options for annotation descriptions.

name: lang-accessibility-screenReaderSection-endOfChartMarker
title: endOfChartMarker
description: Label for the end of the chart. Announced by screen readers.

name: lang-accessibility-series
title: series
description:
Lang configuration for different series types. For more dynamic
control over the series element descriptions, see
[accessibility.seriesDescriptionFormatter](#accessibility.seriesDescriptionFormatter).

name: lang-accessibility-series-description
title: description
description:
User supplied description text. This is added in the point
comment description by default if present.

`{description}` refers to the value given in
[point.accessibility.description](#series.line.data.accessibility.description).

name: lang-accessibility-series-nullPointValue
title: nullPointValue
description: Description for the value of null points.

name: lang-accessibility-series-pointAnnotationsDescription
title: pointAnnotationsDescription
description:
Description for annotations on a point, as it is made available
to assistive technology.

name: lang-accessibility-series-summary
title: summary
description:
Lang configuration for the series main summary. Each series
type has two modes:

1. This series type is the only series type used in the
   chart

2. This is a combination chart with multiple series types

If a definition does not exist for the specific series type
and mode, the 'default' lang definitions are used.

Chart and its subproperties can be accessed with the `{chart}` variable.
The series and its subproperties can be accessed with the `{series}` variable.

The series index (starting from 1) can be accessed with the `{seriesNumber}` variable.

name: lang-accessibility-series-xAxisDescription
title: xAxisDescription
description:
X-axis description for series if there are multiple xAxes in
the chart.

name: lang-accessibility-series-yAxisDescription
title: yAxisDescription
description:
Y-axis description for series if there are multiple yAxes in
the chart.

name: lang-accessibility-seriesTypeDescriptions
title: seriesTypeDescriptions
description:
Descriptions of lesser known series types. The relevant
description is added to the screen reader information region
when these series types are used.

name: lang-accessibility-sonification
title: sonification
description: Language options for sonification.

name: lang-accessibility-stockTools
title: stockTools
description: Stock tools language options for accessibility.

name: lang-accessibility-svgContainerLabel
title: svgContainerLabel
description:
Accessible label for the chart SVG element.
`{chartTitle}` refers to the chart title.

name: lang-accessibility-svgContainerTitle
title: svgContainerTitle
description:
Title element text for the chart SVG element. Leave this
empty to disable adding the title element. Browsers will display
this content when hovering over elements in the chart. Assistive
technology may use this element to label the chart.

name: lang-accessibility-table
title: table
description: Accessibility language options for the data table.

name: lang-accessibility-thousandsSep
title: thousandsSep
description:
Thousands separator to use when formatting numbers for screen
readers. Note that many screen readers will not handle space as a
thousands separator, and will consider "11 700" as two numbers.

Set to `null` to use the separator defined in
[lang.thousandsSep](lang.thousandsSep).

name: lang-accessibility-zoom
title: zoom
description: Chart and map zoom accessibility language options.

name: lang-chartTitle
title: chartTitle
description: The default chart title.

name: lang-contextButtonTitle
title: contextButtonTitle
description:
Exporting module menu. The tooltip title for the context menu holding
print and export menu items.

name: lang-decimalPoint
title: decimalPoint
description:
The default decimal point used in the `Highcharts.numberFormat`
method unless otherwise specified in the function arguments. Defaults
to the locale decimal point as determined by `lang.locale`.

name: lang-downloadCSV
title: downloadCSV
description: The text for the menu item.

name: lang-downloadJPEG
title: downloadJPEG
description: Exporting module only. The text for the JPEG download menu item.

name: lang-downloadMIDI
title: downloadMIDI
description: The text for the MIDI download menu item in the export menu.

name: lang-downloadPDF
title: downloadPDF
description: Exporting module only. The text for the PDF download menu item.

name: lang-downloadPNG
title: downloadPNG
description: Exporting module only. The text for the PNG download menu item.

name: lang-downloadSVG
title: downloadSVG
description: Exporting module only. The text for the SVG download menu item.

name: lang-downloadXLS
title: downloadXLS
description: The text for the menu item.

name: lang-exitFullscreen
title: exitFullscreen
description:
Exporting module only. The text for the menu item to exit the chart
from full screen.

name: lang-exportData
title: exportData
description: The text for exported table.

name: lang-exportData-annotationHeader
title: annotationHeader
description: The annotation column title.

name: lang-exportData-categoryDatetimeHeader
title: categoryDatetimeHeader
description: The category column title when axis type set to "datetime".

name: lang-exportData-categoryHeader
title: categoryHeader
description: The category column title.

name: lang-exportInProgress
title: exportInProgress
description: Text to show when export is in progress.

name: lang-hideData
title: hideData
description: The text for the menu item.

name: lang-invalidDate
title: invalidDate
description:
What to show in a date field for invalid dates. Defaults to an empty
string.

name: lang-loading
title: loading
description:
The loading text that appears when the chart is set into the loading
state following a call to `chart.showLoading`.

name: lang-locale
title: locale
description:
The browser locale to use for date and number formatting. The actual
locale used for each chart is determined in three steps:
1. If this `lang.locale` option is specified, it is used.
2. Else, look for the closest ancestor HTML element with a `lang`
   attribute, typically the `<html>` element.
3. If no 'lang' attribute is found, use the default browser locale.

Use `en-GB`, British English, for approximate consistency with
Highcharts v < 12.

name: lang-mainBreadcrumb
title: mainBreadcrumb
description: The text for the main breadcrumb.

name: lang-months
title: months
description:
An array containing the months names. Corresponds to the `%B` format
in `Highcharts.dateFormat()`. Defaults to 'undefined',
meaning the default month names are used according to the
`lang.locale` or browser settings.

name: lang-navigation
title: navigation
description:
Configure the Popup strings in the chart. Requires the
`annotations.js` or `annotations-advanced.src.js` module to be
loaded.

name: lang-navigation-popup
title: popup
description: Translations for all field names used in popup.

name: lang-noData
title: noData
description: The text to display when the chart contains no data.

name: lang-numericSymbolMagnitude
title: numericSymbolMagnitude
description:
The magnitude of [numericSymbols](#lang.numericSymbol) replacements.
Use 10000 for Japanese, Korean and various Chinese locales, which
use symbols for 10^4, 10^8 and 10^12.

name: lang-numericSymbols
title: numericSymbols
description:
[Metric prefixes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_prefix) used
to shorten high numbers in axis labels. Replacing any of the
positions with `null` causes the full number to be written. Setting
`numericSymbols` to `undefined` disables shortening altogether.

name: lang-pieSliceName
title: pieSliceName
description: The default name for a pie slice (point).

name: lang-playAsSound
title: playAsSound
description: The text for the Play as sound menu item in the export menu.

name: lang-printChart
title: printChart
description: Exporting module only. The text for the menu item to print the chart.

name: lang-rangeSelector
title: rangeSelector
description: The default text for the rangeselector buttons.

name: lang-resetZoom
title: resetZoom
description: The text for the label appearing when a chart is zoomed.

name: lang-resetZoomTitle
title: resetZoomTitle
description: The tooltip title for the label appearing when a chart is zoomed.

name: lang-seriesName
title: seriesName
description: [Format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/templating) for the default series name.

name: lang-shortMonths
title: shortMonths
description:
An array containing the months names in abbreviated form. Corresponds
to the `%b` format in `Highcharts.dateFormat()`. Defaults to
'undefined', meaning the default short month names are used according
to the `lang.locale` or browser settings.

name: lang-shortWeekdays
title: shortWeekdays
description:
Short week days, starting Sunday. Corresponds to the `%a` format in
`Highcharts.dateFormat()`. Defaults to 'undefined', meaning
the default short weekday names are used according to the
`lang.locale` or browser settings.

name: lang-thousandsSep
title: thousandsSep
description:
The default thousands separator used in the `Highcharts.numberFormat`
method unless otherwise specified in the function arguments. Defaults
to the locale thousands separator as determined by `lang.locale`.

name: lang-viewData
title: viewData
description: The text for the menu item.

name: lang-viewFullscreen
title: viewFullscreen
description:
Exporting module only. The text for the menu item to view the chart
in full screen.

name: lang-weekdays
title: weekdays
description:
An array containing the weekday names. Corresponds
to the `%A` format in `Highcharts.dateFormat()`. Defaults to
'undefined', meaning the default weekday names are used according to
the `lang.locale` or browser settings.

name: lang-yAxisTitle
title: yAxisTitle
description: The default title of the Y axis

name: legend
title: legend
description:
The legend is a box containing a symbol and name for each series
item or point item in the chart. Each series (or points in case
of pie charts) is represented by a symbol and its name in the legend.

It is possible to override the symbol creator function and create
[custom legend symbols](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/studies/legend-custom-symbol/).

name: legend-accessibility
title: accessibility
description:
Accessibility options for the legend. Requires the Accessibility
module.

name: legend-accessibility-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable accessibility support for the legend.

name: legend-accessibility-keyboardNavigation
title: keyboardNavigation
description: Options for keyboard navigation for the legend.

name: legend-accessibility-keyboardNavigation-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable keyboard navigation for the legend.

name: legend-align
title: align
description:
The horizontal alignment of the legend box within the chart area.
Valid values are `left`, `center` and `right`.

In the case that the legend is aligned in a corner position, the
`layout` option will determine whether to place it above/below
or on the side of the plot area.

name: legend-alignColumns
title: alignColumns
description:
If the [layout](legend.layout) is `horizontal` and the legend items
span over two lines or more, whether to align the items into vertical
columns. Setting this to `false` makes room for more items, but will
look more messy.

name: legend-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description: The background color of the legend.

name: legend-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The color of the drawn border around the legend.

name: legend-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: The border corner radius of the legend.

name: legend-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The width of the drawn border around the legend.

name: legend-bubbleLegend
title: bubbleLegend
description:
The bubble legend is an additional element in legend which
presents the scale of the bubble series. Individual bubble ranges
can be defined by user or calculated from series. In the case of
automatically calculated ranges, a 1px margin of error is
permitted.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-borderColor
title: borderColor
description:
The color of the ranges borders, can be also defined for an
individual range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description:
The width of the ranges borders in pixels, can be also
defined for an individual range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-className
title: className
description:
An additional class name to apply to the bubble legend'
circle graphical elements. This option does not replace
default class names of the graphical element.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-color
title: color
description:
The main color of the bubble legend. Applies to ranges, if
individual color is not defined.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-connectorClassName
title: connectorClassName
description:
An additional class name to apply to the bubble legend's
connector graphical elements. This option does not replace
default class names of the graphical element.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-connectorColor
title: connectorColor
description:
The color of the connector, can be also defined
for an individual range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-connectorDistance
title: connectorDistance
description:
The length of the connectors in pixels. If labels are
centered, the distance is reduced to 0.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-connectorWidth
title: connectorWidth
description: The width of the connectors in pixels.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable the bubble legend.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels
title: labels
description: Options for the bubble legend labels.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-align
title: align
description:
The alignment of the labels compared to the bubble
legend. Can be one of `left`, `center` or `right`.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description: Whether to allow data labels to overlap.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-className
title: className
description:
An additional class name to apply to the bubble legend
label graphical elements. This option does not replace
default class names of the graphical element.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the bubble legend labels. Available
variables are the same as for `formatter`.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Available `this` properties are:

- `this.value`: The bubble value.

- `this.radius`: The radius of the bubble range.

- `this.center`: The center y position of the range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-style
title: style
description: CSS styles for the labels.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-x
title: x
description:
The x position offset of the label relative to the
connector.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-labels-y
title: y
description:
The y position offset of the label relative to the
connector.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-legendIndex
title: legendIndex
description: The position of the bubble legend in the legend.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-maxSize
title: maxSize
description:
Maximum bubble legend range size. If values for ranges are
not specified, the `minSize` and the `maxSize` are calculated
from bubble series.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-minSize
title: minSize
description:
Minimum bubble legend range size. If values for ranges are
not specified, the `minSize` and the `maxSize` are calculated
from bubble series.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-ranges
title: ranges
description:
Options for specific range. One range consists of bubble,
label and connector.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-ranges-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The color of the border for individual range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-ranges-color
title: color
description: The color of the bubble for individual range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-ranges-connectorColor
title: connectorColor
description: The color of the connector for individual range.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-ranges-value
title: value
description: Range size value, similar to bubble Z data.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-sizeBy
title: sizeBy
description:
Whether the bubble legend range value should be represented
by the area or the width of the bubble. The default, area,
corresponds best to the human perception of the size of each
bubble.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-sizeByAbsoluteValue
title: sizeByAbsoluteValue
description:
When this is true, the absolute value of z determines the
size of the bubble. This means that with the default
zThreshold of 0, a bubble of value -1 will have the same size
as a bubble of value 1, while a bubble of value 0 will have a
smaller size according to minSize.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: Define the visual z index of the bubble legend.

name: legend-bubbleLegend-zThreshold
title: zThreshold
description: Ranges with lower value than zThreshold are skipped.

name: legend-className
title: className
description: A CSS class name to apply to the legend group.

name: legend-enabled
title: enabled
description:
Enable or disable the legend. There is also a series-specific option,
[showInLegend](#plotOptions.series.showInLegend), that can hide the
series from the legend. In some series types this is `false` by
default, so it must set to `true` in order to show the legend for the
series.

name: legend-events
title: events
description:
General event handlers for the legend. These event hooks can
also be attached to the legend at run time using the
`Highcharts.addEvent` function.

name: legend-events-itemClick
title: itemClick
description:
Fires when the legend item belonging to the series is clicked.
One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function. The default
action is to toggle the visibility of the series, point or data
class. This can be prevented by returning `false` or calling
`event.preventDefault()`.

name: legend-floating
title: floating
description:
When the legend is floating, the plot area ignores it and is allowed
to be placed below it.

name: legend-itemCheckboxStyle
title: itemCheckboxStyle
description:
Default styling for the checkbox next to a legend item when
`showCheckbox` is true.

name: legend-itemDistance
title: itemDistance
description:
In a legend with horizontal layout, the itemDistance defines the
pixel distance between each item.

name: legend-itemHiddenStyle
title: itemHiddenStyle
description:
CSS styles for each legend item when the corresponding series or
point is hidden. Only a subset of CSS is supported, notably those
options related to text. Properties are inherited from `style`
unless overridden here.

name: legend-itemHoverStyle
title: itemHoverStyle
description:
CSS styles for each legend item in hover mode. Only a subset of
CSS is supported, notably those options related to text. Properties
are inherited from `style` unless overridden here.

name: legend-itemMarginBottom
title: itemMarginBottom
description: The pixel bottom margin for each legend item.

name: legend-itemMarginTop
title: itemMarginTop
description: The pixel top margin for each legend item.

name: legend-itemStyle
title: itemStyle
description:
CSS styles for each legend item. Only a subset of CSS is supported,
notably those options related to text. The default `textOverflow`
property makes long texts truncate. Set it to `undefined` to wrap
text instead. A `width` property can be added to control the text
width.

name: legend-itemWidth
title: itemWidth
description:
The width for each legend item. By default the items are laid out
successively. In a [horizontal layout](legend.layout), if the items
are laid out across two rows or more, they will be vertically aligned
depending on the [legend.alignColumns](legend.alignColumns) option.

name: legend-labelFormat
title: labelFormat
description:
A [format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
for each legend label. Available variables relates to properties on
the series, or the point in case of pies.

name: legend-labelFormatter
title: labelFormatter
description:
Callback function to format each of the series' labels. The `this`
keyword refers to the series object, or the point object in case of
pie charts. By default the series or point name is printed. Since
v12.5.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the first argument, so
that arrow functions can access the same context as regular
functions using `this`.

name: legend-layout
title: layout
description:
The layout of the legend items. Can be one of `horizontal` or
`vertical` or `proximate`. When `proximate`, the legend items will be
placed as close as possible to the graphs they're representing,
except in inverted charts or when the legend position doesn't allow
it.

name: legend-margin
title: margin
description:
If the plot area sized is calculated automatically and the legend is
not floating, the legend margin is the space between the legend and
the axis labels or plot area.

name: legend-maxHeight
title: maxHeight
description:
Maximum pixel height for the legend. When the maximum height is
extended, navigation will show.

name: legend-maxWidth
title: maxWidth
description:
Maximum width for the legend. Can be a percentage of the chart width,
or an integer representing how many pixels wide the legend can be.

name: legend-navigation
title: navigation
description:
Options for the paging or navigation appearing when the legend is
overflown. Navigation works well on screen, but not in static
exported images. One way of working around that is to
[increase the chart height in
export](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/legend/navigation-enabled-false/).

name: legend-navigation-activeColor
title: activeColor
description:
The color for the active up or down arrow in the legend page
navigation.

name: legend-navigation-animation
title: animation
description:
How to animate the pages when navigating up or down. A value of
`true` applies the default navigation given in the
`chart.animation` option. Additional options can be given as an
object containing values for easing and duration.

name: legend-navigation-arrowSize
title: arrowSize
description:
The pixel size of the up and down arrows in the legend paging
navigation.

name: legend-navigation-enabled
title: enabled
description:
Whether to enable the legend navigation. In most cases, disabling
the navigation results in an unwanted overflow.

See also the
[adapt chart to legend](https://github.com/highcharts/adapt-chart-to-legend)
plugin for a solution to extend the chart height to make room for
the legend, optionally in exported charts only.

name: legend-navigation-inactiveColor
title: inactiveColor
description:
The color of the inactive up or down arrow in the legend page
navigation. .

name: legend-navigation-style
title: style
description: Text styles for the legend page navigation.

name: legend-padding
title: padding
description: The inner padding of the legend box.

name: legend-reversed
title: reversed
description:
Whether to reverse the order of the legend items compared to the
order of the series or points as defined in the configuration object.

name: legend-rtl
title: rtl
description:
Whether to show the symbol on the right side of the text rather than
the left side. This is common in Arabic and Hebrew.

name: legend-shadow
title: shadow
description:
Whether to apply a drop shadow to the legend. A `backgroundColor`
also needs to be applied for this to take effect. The shadow can be
an object configuration containing `color`, `offsetX`, `offsetY`,
`opacity` and `width`.

name: legend-squareSymbol
title: squareSymbol
description:
When this is true, the legend symbol width will be the same as
the symbol height, which in turn defaults to the font size of the
legend items.

name: legend-symbolHeight
title: symbolHeight
description:
The pixel height of the symbol for series types that use a rectangle
in the legend. Defaults to the font size of legend items.

Note: This option is a default source of color axis height, if the
[colorAxis.height](https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/colorAxis.height)
option is not set.

name: legend-symbolPadding
title: symbolPadding
description:
The pixel padding between the legend item symbol and the legend
item text.

name: legend-symbolRadius
title: symbolRadius
description:
The border radius of the symbol for series types that use a rectangle
in the legend. Defaults to half the `symbolHeight`, effectively
creating a circle.

For color axis scales, it defaults to 3.

name: legend-symbolWidth
title: symbolWidth
description:
The pixel width of the legend item symbol. When the `squareSymbol`
option is set, this defaults to the `symbolHeight`, otherwise 16.

Note: This option is a default source of color axis width, if the
[colorAxis.width](https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/colorAxis.width)
option is not set.

name: legend-title
title: title
description: A title to be added on top of the legend.

name: legend-title-style
title: style
description: Generic CSS styles for the legend title.

name: legend-title-text
title: text
description: A text or HTML string for the title.

name: legend-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the legend item texts.

Prior to 4.1.7, when using HTML, [legend.navigation](#legend.navigation) was disabled.

name: legend-valueDecimals
title: valueDecimals
description:
For a color axis with data classes, how many decimals to render in
the legend. The default preserves the decimals of the range numbers.

name: legend-valueSuffix
title: valueSuffix
description:
For a color axis with data classes, a suffix for the range numbers in
the legend.

name: legend-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
The vertical alignment of the legend box. Can be one of `top`,
`middle` or `bottom`. Vertical position can be further determined
by the `y` option.

In the case that the legend is aligned in a corner position, the
`layout` option will determine whether to place it above/below
or on the side of the plot area.

When the [layout](#legend.layout) option is `proximate`, the
`verticalAlign` option doesn't apply.

name: legend-width
title: width
description:
The width of the legend box. If a number is set, it translates to
pixels. Since v7.0.2 it allows setting a percent string of the full
chart width, for example `40%`.

Defaults to the full chart width for legends below or above the
chart, half the chart width for legends to the left and right.

name: legend-x
title: x
description:
The x offset of the legend relative to its horizontal alignment
`align` within chart.spacingLeft and chart.spacingRight. Negative
x moves it to the left, positive x moves it to the right.

name: legend-y
title: y
description:
The vertical offset of the legend relative to it's vertical alignment
`verticalAlign` within chart.spacingTop and chart.spacingBottom.
 Negative y moves it up, positive y moves it down.

name: loading
title: loading
description:
The loading options control the appearance of the loading screen
that covers the plot area on chart operations. This screen only
appears after an explicit call to `chart.showLoading()`. It is a
utility for developers to communicate to the end user that something
is going on, for example while retrieving new data via an XHR connection.
The "Loading..." text itself is not part of this configuration
object, but part of the `lang` object.

name: loading-hideDuration
title: hideDuration
description: The duration in milliseconds of the fade out effect.

name: loading-labelStyle
title: labelStyle
description: CSS styles for the loading label `span`.

name: loading-showDuration
title: showDuration
description: The duration in milliseconds of the fade in effect.

name: loading-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the loading screen that covers the plot area.

In styled mode, the loading label is styled with the
`.highcharts-loading` class.

name: navigation
title: navigation
description:
A collection of options for buttons and menus appearing in the exporting
module or in Stock Tools.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions
title: annotationsOptions
description: Additional options to be merged into all annotations.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-animation
title: animation
description:
Enable or disable the initial animation when a series is
displayed for the `annotation`. The animation can also be set
as a configuration object. Please note that this option only
applies to the initial animation.
For other animations, see [chart.animation](#chart.animation)
and the animation parameter under the API methods.
The following properties are supported:

- `defer`: The animation delay time in milliseconds.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-animation-defer
title: defer
description:
The animation delay time in milliseconds.
Set to `0` renders annotation immediately.
As `undefined` inherits defer time from the [series.animation.defer](#plotOptions.series.animation.defer).

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-className
title: className
description: A class name for styling by CSS.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-controlPointOptions
title: controlPointOptions
description:
Options for annotation's control points. Each control point
inherits options from controlPointOptions object.
Options from the controlPointOptions can be overwritten
by options in a specific control point.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-crop
title: crop
description:
Whether to hide the part of the annotation
that is outside the plot area.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-draggable
title: draggable
description:
Allow an annotation to be draggable by a user. Possible
values are `'x'`, `'xy'`, `'y'` and `''` (disabled).

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-events
title: events
description: Events available in annotations.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-events-add
title: add
description: Event callback when annotation is added to the chart.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-events-afterUpdate
title: afterUpdate
description:
Event callback when annotation is updated (e.g. drag and
dropped or resized by control points).

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-events-click
title: click
description: Fires when the annotation is clicked.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-events-drag
title: drag
description: Fires when the annotation is dragged.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-events-remove
title: remove
description: Event callback when annotation is removed from the chart.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-id
title: id
description:
Sets an ID for an annotation. Can be user later when
removing an annotation in [Chart#removeAnnotation(id)](/class-reference/Highcharts.Chart#removeAnnotation) method.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions
title: labelOptions
description:
Options for annotation's labels. Each label inherits options
from the labelOptions object. An option from the labelOptions
can be overwritten by config for a specific label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-accessibility
title: accessibility
description: Accessibility options for an annotation label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-accessibility-description
title: description
description:
Description of an annotation label for screen readers and other assistive
technology.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-align
title: align
description:
The alignment of the annotation's label. If right,
the right side of the label should be touching the point.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description:
Whether to allow the annotation's labels to overlap.
To make the labels less sensitive for overlapping,
the can be set to 0.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description: The background color or gradient for the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The border color for the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: The border radius in pixels for the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The border width in pixels for the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-className
title: className
description: A class name for styling by CSS.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-crop
title: crop
description:
Whether to hide the annotation's label
that is outside the plot area.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-distance
title: distance
description: The label's pixel distance from the point.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-format
title: format
description:
A
[format](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
string for the data label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the annotation's
label. Note that if a `format` or `text` are defined,
the format or text take precedence and the formatter is
ignored. `This` refers to a point object. The callback also receives
an argument `ctx` so that arrow-functions can access the same
context (the point in this case) as normal functions can using
`this`. Since v12.6.0, the callback receives `ctx`.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-includeInDataExport
title: includeInDataExport
description:
Whether all the labels for an annotation are visible in the exported
data table.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-overflow
title: overflow
description:
How to handle the annotation's label that flow outside
the plot area. The justify option aligns the label inside
the plot area.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-padding
title: padding
description:
When either the borderWidth or the backgroundColor is
set, this is the padding within the box.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-shadow
title: shadow
description:
The shadow of the box. The shadow can be an object
configuration containing `color`, `offsetX`, `offsetY`,
`opacity` and `width`.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-shape
title: shape
description:
The name of a symbol to use for the border around the
label. Symbols are predefined functions on the Renderer
object.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-style
title: style
description: Styles for the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-text
title: text
description: Alias for the format option.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:

to render the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description: The vertical alignment of the annotation's label.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-x
title: x
description:

Note that if a `distance` is defined, the distance takes
precedence over `x` and `y` options.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-labelOptions-y

description:

Note that if a `distance` is defined, the distance takes
precedence over `x` and `y` options.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-shapeOptions-fill

title: r
description:

title: xAxis

[point](#annotations.shapes.point) and
[points](#annotations.shapes.points) coordinates.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-src
title: src
description:
The URL for an image to use as the annotation shape.
Note, type has to be set to `'image'`.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-stroke
title: stroke
description: The color of the shape's stroke.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-strokeWidth
title: strokeWidth
description: The pixel stroke width of the shape.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-type
title: type
description:
The type of the shape.
Available options are `circle`, `rect`, `ellipse` and `path`.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-width
title: width
description:
The width of the `rect` shape. Can be defined in pixels or xAxis
units, if [shapes.xAxis](#annotations.shapeOptions.xAxis) index is
defined.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-xAxis
title: xAxis
description:
The xAxis index which should be used for annotation's sizes and
points coordinates conversion.

This option is used for `rect` shape
[width](#annotations.shapeOptions.width), and all shapes
[point](#annotations.shapes.point) and
[points](#annotations.shapes.points) coordinates.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-line-yAxis
title: yAxis
description:
The yAxis index which should be used for annotation's sizes and
points coordinates conversion.

This option is used for `rect` shape
[height](#annotations.shapeOptions.height), `circle` shape
[radius](#annotations.shapeOptions.r), `ellipse`
[y direction radius](#annotations.shapeOptions.ry), and all shapes
[point](#annotations.shapes.point) and
[points](#annotations.shapes.points) coordinates.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-point
title: point
description:
A single point that the annotation is attached to. It can be either
the point which exists in the series - it is referenced by the
point's id - or a new point with defined x, y properties
and optionally axes.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-points
title: points
description:
An array of points that the annotation is attached to. Each point can
the point which exists in the series - it is referenced by the
point's id - or a new point with defined x, y properties
and optionally axes.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-type
title: type
description: The annotation type identifier.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-xAxis
title: xAxis
description:
This option defines which `xAxis` the point is connected to.
It refers to either the axis id or the index of the axis
in the `xAxis` array.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-typeOptions-yAxis
title: yAxis
description:
This option defines which `yAxis` the point is connected to.
It refers to either the axis id or the index of the axis
in the `yAxis` array.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-visible
title: visible
description: Whether the annotation is visible.

name: navigation-annotationsOptions-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index of the annotation.

name: navigation-bindings-verticalLabel-annotationsOptions
title: annotationsOptions
description: Options to customize the bindings' annotation shapes and labels.

name: navigation-bindingsClassName
title: bindingsClassName
description:
A CSS class name where all bindings will be attached to. Multiple
charts on the same page should have separate class names to prevent
duplicating events.

Default value of versions < 7.0.4 `highcharts-bindings-wrapper`

name: navigation-breadcrumbs
title: breadcrumbs
description:
Options for breadcrumbs. Breadcrumbs general options are defined in
`navigation.breadcrumbs`. Specific options for drilldown are set in
`drilldown.breadcrumbs` and for tree-like series traversing, in
`plotOptions[series].breadcrumbs`.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-buttonSpacing
title: buttonSpacing
description: The default padding for each button and separator in each direction.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-buttonTheme
title: buttonTheme
description:
A collection of attributes for the buttons. The object takes SVG
attributes like `fill`, `stroke`, `stroke-width`, as well as `style`,
a collection of CSS properties for the text.

The object can also be extended with states, so you can set
presentational options for `hover`, `select` or `disabled` button
states.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-events-click
title: click

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-floating
title: floating
description:
When the breadcrumbs are floating, the plot area will not move to
make space for it. By default, the chart will not make space for the
buttons. This property won't work when positioned in the middle.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the breadcrumbs button. Variables are enclosed by
curly brackets. Available values are passed in the declared point
options.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-formatter
title: formatter
description: Callback function to format the breadcrumb text from scratch.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-position
title: position
description:
Positioning for the button row. The breadcrumbs buttons will be
aligned properly for the default chart layout (title,  subtitle,
legend, range selector) for the custom chart layout set the position
properties.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-position-align
title: align
description: Horizontal alignment of the breadcrumbs buttons.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-position-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description: Vertical alignment of the breadcrumbs buttons.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-position-x
title: x
description: The X offset of the breadcrumbs button group.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-position-y
title: y
description:
The Y offset of the breadcrumbs button group. When `undefined`,
and `floating` is `false`, the `y` position is adapted so that
the breadcrumbs are rendered outside the target area.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-relativeTo
title: relativeTo
description:
What box to align the button to. Can be either `plotBox` or
`spacingBox`.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-rtl
title: rtl
description:
Whether to reverse the order of buttons. This is common in Arabic
and Hebrew.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-separator
title: separator
description: Options object for Breadcrumbs separator.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-separator-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the breadcrumbs separator.

In styled mode, the breadcrumbs separators are styled by the
`.highcharts-separator` rule with its different states.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-showFullPath
title: showFullPath
description: Show full path or only a single button.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for all breadcrumbs.

In styled mode, the breadcrumbs buttons are styled by the
`.highcharts-breadcrumbs-buttons .highcharts-button` rule with its
different states.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-useHTML
title: useHTML
description: Whether to use HTML to render the breadcrumbs items texts.

name: navigation-breadcrumbs-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The z index of the breadcrumbs group.

name: navigation-buttonOptions
title: buttonOptions
description:
A collection of options for buttons appearing in the exporting
module.

In styled mode, the buttons are styled with the
`.highcharts-contextbutton` and `.highcharts-button-symbol` classes.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-align
title: align
description: Alignment for the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-buttonSpacing
title: buttonSpacing
description:
The pixel spacing between buttons, and between the context button and
the title.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-enabled
title: enabled
description: Whether to enable buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-height
title: height
description: Pixel height of the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolFill
title: symbolFill
description: Fill color for the symbol within the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolSize
title: symbolSize
description: The pixel size of the symbol on the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolStroke
title: symbolStroke
description: The color of the symbol's stroke or line.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolStrokeWidth
title: symbolStrokeWidth
description: The pixel stroke width of the symbol on the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolX
title: symbolX
description: The x position of the center of the symbol inside the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolY
title: symbolY
description: The y position of the center of the symbol inside the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-text
title: text
description: A text string to add to the individual button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme
title: theme
description:
A configuration object for the button theme. The object accepts
SVG properties like `stroke-width`, `stroke` and `fill`.
Tri-state button styles are supported by the `states.hover` and
`states.select` objects.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-fill
title: fill
description: The default fill exists only to capture hover events.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-padding
title: padding
description: Padding for the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states
title: states
description: Tri-state button styles.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states-disabled
title: disabled
description: SVG attributes for the disabled state of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states-hover
title: hover
description: SVG attributes for the hovered state of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states-select
title: select
description: SVG attributes for the selected state of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-stroke
title: stroke
description: Default stroke for the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-stroke-linecap
title: stroke-linecap
description: Default stroke linecap for the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-style
title: style
description: CSS styling for the button's text or symbol.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to use HTML for rendering the button. HTML allows for things
like inline CSS or image-based icons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
The vertical alignment of the buttons. Can be one of `"top"`,
`"middle"` or `"bottom"`.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-width
title: width
description: The pixel width of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-y
title: y
description:
The vertical offset of the button's position relative to its
`verticalAlign`. By default adjusted for the chart title alignment.

name: navigation-events
title: events
description: Events to communicate between Stock Tools and custom GUI.

name: navigation-events-closePopup
title: closePopup
description:
A `closePopup` event. Fired when Popup should be hidden, for example
when clicking on an annotation again.

name: navigation-events-deselectButton
title: deselectButton
description:
Event fired when button state should change, for example after
adding an annotation.

name: navigation-events-selectButton
title: selectButton
description: Event fired on a button click.

name: navigation-events-showPopup
title: showPopup
description: A `showPopup` event. Fired when selecting for example an annotation.

name: navigation-iconsURL
title: iconsURL
description:
Path where Highcharts will look for icons. Change this to use icons
from a different server. When undefined, icons are loaded from
the library's internal source.

name: navigation-menuItemHoverStyle
title: menuItemHoverStyle
description:
CSS styles for the hover state of the individual items within the
popup menu appearing by default when the export icon is clicked. The
menu items are rendered in HTML.

name: navigation-menuItemStyle
title: menuItemStyle
description:
CSS styles for the individual items within the popup menu appearing
by default when the export icon is clicked. The menu items are
rendered in HTML. Font size defaults to `11px` on desktop and `14px`
on touch devices.

name: navigation-menuStyle
title: menuStyle
description:
CSS styles for the popup menu appearing by default when the export
icon is clicked. This menu is rendered in HTML.

name: noData
title: noData
description:
Options for displaying a message like "No data to display".
This feature requires the file no-data-to-display.js to be loaded in the
page. The actual text to display is set in the lang.noData option.

name: noData-attr
title: attr
description: An object of additional SVG attributes for the no-data label.

name: noData-position
title: position
description: The position of the no-data label, relative to the plot area.

name: noData-position-align
title: align
description: Horizontal alignment of the label.

name: noData-position-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description: Vertical alignment of the label.

name: noData-position-x
title: x
description: Horizontal offset of the label, in pixels.

name: noData-position-y
title: y
description: Vertical offset of the label, in pixels.

name: noData-style
title: style
description: CSS styles for the no-data label.

name: noData-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to insert the label as HTML, or as pseudo-HTML rendered with
SVG.

name: palette
title: palette
description:
The palette object specifies colors for the charts and how to apply them.

Each color scheme (`light` and `dark`) has three primary colors:
`backgroundColor`, `neutralColor`, and `highlightColor`. For the neutral and
highlight colors, a series of interpolated color variants are generated, and
accessed as CSS variables in the chart settings in their prefixed and
hyphenated form. For example,

* `var(--highcharts-neutral-color-80)` is a blend of the `neutralColor` and
  the `backgroundColor`, with a weight of 80% `neutralColor` and 20%
  `backgroundColor`. It is the default for the main title
  (`title.style.color`), axis labels and more.
* `var(--highcharts-highlight-color-80)` is a blend of the `highlightColor`
  and the `backgroundColor`, with a weight of 80% `highlightColor` and 20%
  `backgroundColor`. It is used for the zoom selection marker (with opacity),
  Stock Range Selector date input boxes and more.

The `colors` array is used for data series and points, and is not blended
with the `backgroundColor`. It is also accessible as CSS variables, and this
is the recommended way to hard-code colors to match series and data.
For example, `var(--highcharts-color-0)` is the first color in the `colors`
array, `var(--highcharts-color-1)` is the second color, and so on.

The palette only accepts plain color strings in the options. Gradients and
patterns are only supported in other color settings, such as `series.color`
or `point.color`, but they can use CSS variables from the palette.

name: palette-colorScheme
title: colorScheme
description:
Color scheme to use. When `light dark` is set, the chart will
automatically switch between light and dark mode based on the user's
system preferences, or whether the `.highcharts-light` or
`.highcharts-dark` class is applied to a parent of the container.

When `inherit` is set, the chart will inherit the color scheme from the
closest parent element with a defined color scheme, or default to `light`
if none is found.

name: palette-colors
title: colors
description:
Colors for data series and points. This setting is generic for both
light and dark mode, and can be overridden for each mode in
`light.colors` and `dark.colors`.

name: palette-dark
title: dark
description: Palette options for dark mode.

name: palette-dark-colors
title: colors
description:
Colors for data series and points. This array extends the colors
defined for the general `palette.colors` array, item by item. If an
item is `null` or `undefined`, the general color will be used.

name: palette-dark-negativeColor
title: negativeColor
description:
Negative color used in stock charts, such as for technical
indicators, annotations or hollow candlestick series.

name: palette-dark-positiveColor
title: positiveColor
description:
Positive color used in stock charts, such as for technical
indicators, annotations or hollow candlestick series.

name: palette-injectCSS
title: injectCSS
description:
Whether to inject the CSS for the dark and light mode. If not injected,
you need to include the CSS manually in your page or application, with
the appropriate CSS variables. A file with the default CSS variables is
available at
[css/highcharts-palette.css](https://code.highcharts.com/css/highcharts-palette.css).

name: palette-light
title: light
description: Palette options for light mode.

name: palette-light-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description:
Chart background, point stroke for markers and columns etc. The
background is also used as base for interpolated neutral and
highlight colors.

name: palette-light-colors
title: colors
description:
Colors for data series and points. This array extends the colors
defined for the general `palette.colors` array, item by item. If an
item is `null` or `undefined`, the general color will be used.

name: palette-light-highlightColor
title: highlightColor
description:
Highlight color to be used as base for interpolated colors. For
example, `var(--highcharts-highlight-color-60)` is a blend of the
`highlightColor` and the `backgroundColor`, with a weight of 60%
`highlightColor` and 40% `backgroundColor`.

Highlight colors are by default used for highlighted or active
elements, like the zoom selection marker, clickable Stock Range
Selector date input boxes, clickable drilldown labels and more.

name: palette-light-negativeColor
title: negativeColor
description:
Negative color used in stock charts, such as for technical
indicators, annotations or hollow candlestick series.

name: palette-light-neutralColor
title: neutralColor
description:
Neutral color to be used as base for interpolated colors. For
example, `var(--highcharts-neutral-color-60)` is a blend of the
`neutralColor` and the `backgroundColor`, with a weight of 60%
`neutralColor` and 40% `backgroundColor`.

Neutral colors are by default used for basic text, lines, borders,
basically most elements except the data itself, and highlighted
elements.

name: palette-light-positiveColor
title: positiveColor
description:
Positive color used in stock charts, such as for technical
indicators, annotations or hollow candlestick series.

name: pane
title: pane
description:
The pane serves as a container for axes and backgrounds for circular
gauges and polar charts.

When used in `Highcharts.setOptions` for theming, the pane must be a single
object, otherwise arrays are supported.

name: pane-background
title: background
description:
A background item or an array of such for the pane. When used in
`Highcharts.setOptions` for theming, the background must be a single item.

name: pane-background-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description: The background color or gradient for the pane.

name: pane-background-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The pane background border color.

name: pane-background-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
The specific border radius of the pane background when the shape is
`arc`. Can be a number (pixels) or a percentage string. Defaults to the
value of `pane.borderRadius`.

name: pane-background-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The pixel border width of the pane background.

name: pane-background-className
title: className
description: An additional class name to apply to the pane background.

name: pane-background-innerRadius
title: innerRadius
description:
The inner radius of the pane background. Can be either numeric
(pixels) or a percentage string. Defaults to match the `pane.innerSize`.

name: pane-background-outerRadius
title: outerRadius
description:
The outer radius of the circular pane background. Can be either
numeric (pixels) or a percentage string.

name: pane-background-shape
title: shape
description:
The shape of the pane background. When `solid`, the background
is circular. When `arc`, the background extends only from the min
to the max of the value axis.

name: pane-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
The border radius of the elements of the pane. This affects the pane
background, plot bands and solid gauges, unless they have specific
border radius settings.

name: pane-center
title: center
description:
The center of a polar chart or angular gauge, given as an array of [x, y]
positions. Positions can be given as integers that transform to pixels,
or as percentages of the plot area size.

By default, the center is calculated to fit the plot area, depending on
the `startAngle` and `endAngle`, `margin`, background shape, axis labels,
and gauge data labels.

name: pane-endAngle
title: endAngle
description:
The end angle of the polar X axis or gauge value axis, given in
degrees where 0 is north. Defaults to [startAngle](#pane.startAngle)
+ 360 for polar charts, `startAngle` + 240 for gauges.

name: pane-innerSize
title: innerSize
description:
The inner size of the pane, either as a number defining pixels, or a
percentage defining a percentage of the pane's size. Defaults to 0 on
polar charts, 80% on gauges.

name: pane-margin
title: margin
description:
The margin between the pane and the plot area when auto-fitting the pane.
This does not apply when an explicit `pane.size` is set. An array sets
individual margins for the sides in the order [top, right, bottom, left].

By default, the margin is approximated to make room for the radial axis
labels of a gauge chart.

name: pane-size
title: size
description:
The size of the pane, either as a number defining pixels, or a percentage
defining a percentage of the available plot area (the smallest of the
plot height or plot width).

By default, the size is calculated to fit the plot area, depending on the
`startAngle` and `endAngle`, `margin`, background shape, axis labels,
and gauge data labels.

name: pane-startAngle
title: startAngle
description:
The start angle of the polar X axis or gauge axis, given in degrees
where 0 is north. Defaults to 0 for polar charts, -135 for gauges.

name: pane-thickness
title: thickness
description:
The thickness of the pane in terms of pixels. This applies to the pane
background, plot bands and solid gauges. Use this for a fixed width pane
across different sizes, where `size` and `innerSize` are not practical.

name: plotOptions
title: plotOptions
description:
The plotOptions is a wrapper object for config objects for each series
type. The config objects for each series can also be overridden for
each series item as given in the series array.

Configuration options for the series are given in three levels. Options
for all series in a chart are given in the [plotOptions.series](#plotOptions.series) object. Then options for all series of a specific
type are given in the plotOptions of that type, for example
`plotOptions.line`. Next, options for one single series are given in
[the series array](#series).

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram
title: arcdiagram

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram-centeredLinks
title: centeredLinks
description:
The option to center links rather than position them one after
another

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description:
Options for the data labels appearing on top of the nodes and links.
For arc diagram charts, data labels are visible for the nodes by
default, but hidden for links. This is controlled by modifying the
`nodeFormat`, and the `format` that applies to links and is an empty
string by default.

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram-dataLabels-linkTextPath
title: linkTextPath
description:
Options for a _link_ label text which should follow link
connection. Border and background are disabled for a label that
follows a path.

**Note:** Only SVG-based renderer supports this option. Setting
`useHTML` to true will disable this option.

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram-equalNodes
title: equalNodes
description:
Whether nodes with different values should have the same size. If set
to true, all nodes are calculated based on the `nodePadding` and
current `plotArea`. It is possible to override it using the
`marker.radius` option.

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram-marker
title: marker
description:
Options for the point markers of arc diagram series. Properties like
`fillColor`, `lineColor` and `lineWidth` define the visual appearance of
the markers, while the `symbol` option defines their shape.

In styled mode, the markers can be styled with the `.highcharts-point`,
`.highcharts-point-hover` and `.highcharts-point-select` class names.

name: plotOptions-arcdiagram-reversed
title: reversed
description:
Whether the series should be placed on the other side of the
`plotArea`.

name: plotOptions-area
title: area

name: plotOptions-area-fillColor
title: fillColor
description:
Fill color or gradient for the area. When `undefined`, the series'
`color` is used with the series' `fillOpacity`.

In styled mode, the fill color can be set with the `.highcharts-area`
class name.

name: plotOptions-area-fillOpacity
title: fillOpacity
description:
Fill opacity for the area. When you set an explicit `fillColor`,
the `fillOpacity` is not applied. Instead, you should define the
opacity in the `fillColor` with an rgba color definition. The
`fillOpacity` setting, also the default setting, overrides the alpha
component of the `color` setting.

In styled mode, the fill opacity can be set with the
`.highcharts-area` class name.

name: plotOptions-area-lineColor
title: lineColor
description:
A separate color for the graph line. By default the line takes the
`color` of the series, but the lineColor setting allows setting a
separate color for the line without altering the `fillColor`.

In styled mode, the line stroke can be set with the
`.highcharts-graph` class name.

name: plotOptions-area-negativeFillColor
title: negativeFillColor
description:
A separate color for the negative part of the area. Note that `zones`
takes precedence over the negative fill color.

In styled mode, a negative color is set with the
`.highcharts-negative` class name.

name: plotOptions-area-threshold
title: threshold
description:
The Y axis value to serve as the base for the area, for
distinguishing between values above and below a threshold. The area
between the graph and the threshold is filled.

* If a number is given, the Y axis will scale to the threshold.
* If `null`, the scaling behaves like a line series with fill between
  the graph and the Y axis minimum.
* If `Infinity` or `-Infinity`, the area between the graph and the
  corresponding Y axis extreme is filled (since v6.1.0).

name: plotOptions-area-trackByArea
title: trackByArea
description:
Whether the whole area or just the line should respond to mouseover
tooltips and other mouse or touch events.

name: plotOptions-arearange
title: arearange

name: plotOptions-arearange-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description:
Extended data labels for range series types. Range series data
labels can be positioned individually by defining them as an array
and setting `alignToKey` to `high` or `low`.

name: plotOptions-arearange-dataLabels-alignToKey
title: alignToKey
description:
The point key to use for positioning this data label.
Possible values are `low` and `high`. In the legacy array form, the first
label defaults to `high` and the second label defaults to `low`.

name: plotOptions-arearange-dataLabels-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the data label. Note that if a
`format` is defined, the format takes precedence and the formatter is
ignored.

By default, the data label renders the value of the point key it is
[aligned to](#plotOptions.arearange.dataLabels.alignToKey). Define a
[format](#plotOptions.arearange.dataLabels.format) or `formatter` to
display other values.

name: plotOptions-arearange-dragDrop-draggableHigh
title: draggableHigh
description: Allow high value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-arearange-dragDrop-draggableLow
title: draggableLow
description: Allow low value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-arearange-lowMarker
title: lowMarker
description:
Options for the lower markers of the arearange-like series. When `lowMarker`
is not defined, options inherit from the marker.

name: plotOptions-arearange-shadow
title: shadow
description:
Whether to apply a drop shadow to the graph line. Since 2.3 the
shadow can be an object configuration containing `color`, `offsetX`,
`offsetY`, `opacity` and `width`.

name: plotOptions-areaspline
title: areaspline

name: plotOptions-areasplinerange
title: areasplinerange

name: plotOptions-bar
title: bar

name: plotOptions-bellcurve
title: bellcurve

name: plotOptions-bellcurve-intervals
title: intervals
description:
This option allows to define the length of the bell curve. A unit of
the length of the bell curve is standard deviation.

name: plotOptions-bellcurve-pointsInInterval
title: pointsInInterval
description:
Defines how many points should be plotted within 1 interval. See
`plotOptions.bellcurve.intervals`.

name: plotOptions-boxplot
title: boxplot

name: plotOptions-boxplot-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
The corner radius of the border surrounding the box. A number
signifies pixels. A percentage string, like for example `50%`, signifies
a size relative to the box width.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-boxDashStyle
title: boxDashStyle
description: The dash style of the box.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-dataLabels-alignToKey
title: alignToKey
description:
The point key to use for positioning this data label.
Possible values are `low`, `q1`, `median`, `q3` and `high`.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-dragDrop-draggableHigh
title: draggableHigh
description: Allow high value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-dragDrop-draggableLow
title: draggableLow
description: Allow low value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-dragDrop-draggableQ1
title: draggableQ1
description: Allow Q1 value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-dragDrop-draggableQ3
title: draggableQ3
description: Allow Q3 value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-fillColor
title: fillColor
description:
The fill color of the box.

In styled mode, the fill color can be set with the
`.highcharts-boxplot-box` class.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description:
The width of the line surrounding the box. If any of
[stemWidth](#plotOptions.boxplot.stemWidth),
[medianWidth](#plotOptions.boxplot.medianWidth)
or [whiskerWidth](#plotOptions.boxplot.whiskerWidth) are `null`,
the lineWidth also applies to these lines.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-medianColor
title: medianColor
description:
The color of the median line. If `undefined`, the general series
color applies.

In styled mode, the median stroke width can be set with the
`.highcharts-boxplot-median` class.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-medianDashStyle
title: medianDashStyle
description: The dash style of the median.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-medianWidth
title: medianWidth
description:
The pixel width of the median line. If `null`, the
[lineWidth](#plotOptions.boxplot.lineWidth) is used.

In styled mode, the median stroke width can be set with the
`.highcharts-boxplot-median` class.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-stemColor
title: stemColor
description:
The color of the stem, the vertical line extending from the box to
the whiskers. If `undefined`, the series color is used.

In styled mode, the stem stroke can be set with the
`.highcharts-boxplot-stem` class.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-stemDashStyle
title: stemDashStyle
description:
The dash style of the stem, the vertical line extending from the
box to the whiskers.

name: plotOptions-boxplot-stemWidth
title: stemWidth
description:
The width of the stem, the vertical line extending from the box to
the whiskers. If `undefined`, the width is inherited from the
