name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-activeWhen-max
title: max
description: Track is only active when `prop` is below or at this value.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-activeWhen-min
title: min
description: Track is only active when `prop` is above or at this value.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-activeWhen-prop
title: prop
description: The point property to compare, for example `y` or `x`.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-instrument
title: instrument
description:
Instrument to use for playing.

Can either be a string referencing a synth preset, or it can be
a synth configuration object.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-frequency
title: frequency
description: Frequency in Hertz of notes. Overrides pitch mapping if set.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-gapBetweenNotes
title: gapBetweenNotes
description:
Gap in milliseconds between notes if pitch is mapped to an
array of notes.

Can be set to a fixed value, a prop to map to, a function,
or a mapping object.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-highpass
title: highpass
description:
Mapping options for the highpass filter.

A highpass filter lets high frequencies through, but stops
low frequencies, making the sound thinner.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-highpass-frequency
title: frequency
description: Map to filter frequency in Hertz from 1 to 20,000Hz.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-highpass-resonance
title: resonance
description:
Map to filter resonance in dB. Can be negative to cause a
dip, or positive to cause a bump.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-lowpass
title: lowpass
description:
Mapping options for the lowpass filter.

A lowpass filter lets low frequencies through, but stops high
frequencies, making the sound more dull.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-lowpass-frequency
title: frequency
description: Map to filter frequency in Hertz from 1 to 20,000Hz.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-lowpass-resonance
title: resonance
description:
Map to filter resonance in dB. Can be negative to cause a
dip, or positive to cause a bump.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-noteDuration
title: noteDuration
description:
Note duration determines for how long a note plays, in
milliseconds.

It only affects instruments that are able to play
continuous sustained notes. Examples of these instruments
from the presets include `flute`, `saxophone`, `trumpet`,
`sawsynth`, `wobble`, `basic1`, `basic2`, `sine`,
`sineGlide`, `triangle`, `square`, `sawtooth`, `noise`,
`filteredNoise`, and `wind`.

Can be set to a fixed value, a prop to map to, a function,
or a mapping object.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-pan
title: pan
description:
Pan refers to the stereo panning position of the sound.
It is defined from -1 (left) to 1 (right).

By default it is mapped to `x`, making the sound move from
left to right as the chart plays.

Can be set to a fixed value, a prop to map to, a function,
or a mapping object.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-pitch
title: pitch
description:
Musical pitch refers to how high or low notes are played.

By default it is mapped to `y` so low `y` values are played
with a lower pitch, and high values are played with a higher
pitch.

Pitch mapping has a few extra features compared to other
audio parameters.

Firstly, it accepts not only number values, but also string
values denoting note names. These are given in the form
`<note><octave>`, for example `"c6"` or `"F#2"`.

Secondly, it is possible to map pitch to an array of notes.
In this case, the `[gapBetweenNotes](#sonification.defaultInstrumentOptions.mapping.gapBetweenNotes)`
mapping determines the delay between these notes.

Thirdly, it is possible to define a musical scale to follow
when mapping.

Can be set to a fixed value, an array, a prop to map to, a
function, or a mapping object.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-pitch-scale
title: scale
description:
Map pitches to a musical scale. The scale is defined as an
array of semitone offsets from the root note.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-playDelay
title: playDelay
description:
Milliseconds to wait before playing, comes in addition to
the time determined by the `time` mapping.

Can also be negative to play before the mapped time.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time
title: time
description:
Time mapping determines what time each point plays. It is
defined as an offset in milliseconds, where 0 means it
plays immediately when the chart is sonified.

By default time is mapped to `x`, meaning points with the
lowest `x` value plays first, and points with the highest
`x` value plays last.

Can be set to a fixed value, a prop to map to, a function,
or a mapping object.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time-mapFunction
title: mapFunction
description: How to perform the mapping.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time-mapTo
title: mapTo
description:
A point property to map the mapping parameter to.

A negative sign `-` can be placed before the property name
to make mapping inverted.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time-max
title: max
description:
The maximum value for the audio parameter. This is the
highest value the audio parameter will be mapped to.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time-min
title: min
description:
The minimum value for the audio parameter. This is the
lowest value the audio parameter will be mapped to.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time-value
title: value
description:
A fixed value to use for the prop when mapping.

For example, if mapping to `y`, setting value to `4` will
map as if all points had a y value of 4.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-time-within
title: within
description:
What data values to map the parameter within.

Mapping within `"series"` will make the lowest value point
in the series map to the min audio parameter value, and the
highest value will map to the max audio parameter.

Mapping within `"chart"` will make the lowest value point in
the whole chart map to the min audio parameter value, and
the highest value in the whole chart will map to the max
audio parameter.

You can also map within the X or Y axis of each series.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-tremolo
title: tremolo
description:
Mapping options for tremolo effects.

Tremolo is repeated changes of volume over time.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-tremolo-depth
title: depth
description:
Map to tremolo depth, from 0 to 1.

This determines the intensity of the tremolo effect, how
much the volume changes.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-tremolo-speed
title: speed
description:
Map to tremolo speed, from 0 to 1.

This determines the speed of the tremolo effect, how fast
the volume changes.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-volume
title: volume
description: The volume of notes, from 0 to 1.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate
title: rate
description: Rate mapping for speech tracks.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate-mapFunction
title: mapFunction
description: How to perform the mapping.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate-mapTo
title: mapTo
description:
A point property to map the mapping parameter to.

A negative sign `-` can be placed before the property name
to make mapping inverted.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate-max
title: max
description:
The maximum value for the audio parameter. This is the
highest value the audio parameter will be mapped to.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate-min
title: min
description:
The minimum value for the audio parameter. This is the
lowest value the audio parameter will be mapped to.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate-value
title: value
description:
A fixed value to use for the prop when mapping.

For example, if mapping to `y`, setting value to `4` will
map as if all points had a y value of 4.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-rate-within
title: within
description:
What data values to map the parameter within.

Mapping within `"series"` will make the lowest value point
in the series map to the min audio parameter value, and the
highest value will map to the max audio parameter.

Mapping within `"chart"` will make the lowest value point in
the whole chart map to the min audio parameter value, and
the highest value in the whole chart will map to the max
audio parameter.

You can also map within the X or Y axis of each series.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-mapping-text
title: text
description: Text mapping for speech tracks.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-midiName
title: midiName
description:
Name to use for a track when exporting to MIDI.
By default it uses the series name if the track is related to
a series.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-pointGrouping
title: pointGrouping
description: Options for point grouping, specifically for instrument tracks.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-pointGrouping-algorithm
title: algorithm
description:
The grouping algorithm, deciding which points to keep when
grouping a set of points together. By default `"minmax"` is
used, which keeps both the minimum and maximum points.

The other algorithms will either keep the first point in the
group (time wise), last point, middle point, or both the first
and the last point.

The timing of the resulting point(s) is then adjusted to play
evenly, regardless of its original position within the group.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-pointGrouping-enabled
title: enabled
description: Whether or not to group points

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-pointGrouping-groupTimespan
title: groupTimespan
description:
The size of each group in milliseconds. Audio events closer than
this are grouped together.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-pointGrouping-prop
title: prop
description:
The data property for each point to compare when deciding which
points to keep in the group.

By default it is "y", which means that if the `"minmax"`
algorithm is used, the two points the group with the lowest and
highest `y` value will be kept, and the others not played.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-roundToMusicalNotes
title: roundToMusicalNotes
description:
Round pitch mapping to musical notes.

If `false`, will play the exact mapped note, even if it is out
of tune compared to the musical notes as defined by 440Hz
standard tuning.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-showPlayMarker
title: showPlayMarker
description: Show play marker (tooltip and/or crosshair) for a track.

name: plotOptions-series-sonification-tracks-type
title: type
description:
Type of track. Always `"instrument"` for instrument tracks, and
`"speech"` for speech tracks.

name: plotOptions-series-stacking
title: stacking
description:
Whether to stack the values of each series on top of each other.
Possible values are null to disable, `"normal"` to stack by
value or `"percent"`.

When stacking is enabled, data must be sorted
in ascending X order.

Some stacking options are related to specific series types. In the
streamgraph series type, the stacking option is set to `"stream"`.
The second one is `"overlap"`, which only applies to waterfall
series.

name: plotOptions-series-states
title: states
description:
A collection of options for different series states.

In addition to the options documented under each state, any option from
the parent series type can be set, with exception of `data` and `states`.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover
title: hover
description:
Options for the hovered series. These settings override the
normal state options when a series is moused over or touched.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-animation
title: animation
description: Animation setting for hovering the graph in line-type series.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-animation-duration
title: duration
description:
The duration of the hover animation in milliseconds. By
default the hover state animates quickly in, and slowly
back to normal.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-enabled
title: enabled
description:
Enable separate styles for the hovered series to visualize
that the user hovers either the series itself or the legend.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-halo
title: halo
description:
Options for the halo appearing around the hovered point in
line-type series as well as outside the hovered slice in pie
charts. By default the halo is filled by the current point or
series color with an opacity of 0.25\. The halo can be
disabled by setting the `halo` option to `null`.

In styled mode, the halo is styled with the
`.highcharts-halo` class, with colors inherited from
`.highcharts-color-{n}`.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-halo-attributes
title: attributes
description:
A collection of SVG attributes to override the appearance
of the halo, for example `fill`, `stroke` and
`stroke-width`.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-halo-opacity
title: opacity
description:
Opacity for the halo unless a specific fill is overridden
using the `attributes` setting.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-halo-size
title: size
description:
The pixel size of the halo. For point markers this is the
radius of the halo. For pie slices it is the width of the
halo outside the slice. For bubbles it defaults to 5 and
is the width of the halo outside the bubble.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description:
Pixel width of the graph line. By default this property is
undefined, and the `lineWidthPlus` property dictates how much
to increase the linewidth from normal state.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-lineWidthPlus
title: lineWidthPlus
description: The additional line width for the graph of a hovered series.

name: plotOptions-series-states-hover-marker
title: marker
description:
In Highcharts 1.0, the appearance of all markers belonging
to the hovered series. For settings on the hover state of the
individual point, see
[marker.states.hover](#plotOptions.series.marker.states.hover).

name: plotOptions-series-states-inactive
title: inactive
description: The opposite state of a hover for series.

name: plotOptions-series-states-inactive-animation
title: animation
description: Animation when not hovering over the marker.

name: plotOptions-series-states-inactive-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable the inactive state for a series

name: plotOptions-series-states-inactive-opacity
title: opacity
description: Opacity of series elements (dataLabels, line, area).

name: plotOptions-series-states-normal
title: normal
description:
The normal state of a series, or for point items in column, pie
and similar series. Currently only used for setting animation
when returning to normal state from hover.

name: plotOptions-series-states-normal-animation
title: animation
description: Animation when returning to normal state after hovering.

name: plotOptions-series-states-select
title: select
description:
Specific options for point in selected states, after being
selected by
[allowPointSelect](#plotOptions.series.allowPointSelect)
or programmatically.

name: plotOptions-series-step
title: step
description:
Whether to apply steps to the line. Possible values are `left`,
`center` and `right`.

name: plotOptions-series-stickyTracking
title: stickyTracking
description:
Sticky tracking of mouse events. When true, the `mouseOut` event on a
series isn't triggered until the mouse moves over another series, or
out of the plot area. When false, the `mouseOut` event on a series is
triggered when the mouse leaves the area around the series' graph or
markers. This also implies the tooltip when not shared. When
`stickyTracking` is false and `tooltip.shared` is false, the tooltip
will be hidden when moving the mouse between series. Defaults to true
for line and area type series, but to false for columns, pies etc.

**Note:** The boost module will force this option because of
technical limitations.

name: plotOptions-series-threshold
title: threshold
description:
The threshold, also called zero level or base level. For line type
series this is only used in conjunction with
[negativeColor](#plotOptions.series.negativeColor).

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip
title: tooltip
description:
A configuration object for the tooltip rendering of each single
series. Properties are inherited from [tooltip](#tooltip), but only
the following properties can be defined on a series level.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-clusterFormat
title: clusterFormat
description:
The HTML of the cluster point's in the tooltip. Works only with
marker-clusters module and analogously to
[pointFormat](#tooltip.pointFormat).

The cluster tooltip can be also formatted using
`tooltip.formatter` callback function and `point.isCluster` flag.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-dateTimeLabelFormats
title: dateTimeLabelFormats
description:
For series on datetime axes, the date format in the tooltip's
header will by default be guessed based on the closest data points.
This member gives the default string representations used for
each unit. For an overview of the string or object configuration, see
[dateFormat](/class-reference/Highcharts.Time#dateFormat).

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-distance
title: distance
description: Distance from point to tooltip in pixels.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-followPointer
title: followPointer
description:
Whether the tooltip should follow the mouse as it moves across
columns, pie slices and other point types with an extent.
By default it behaves this way for pie, polygon, map, sankey
and wordcloud series by override in the `plotOptions`
for those series types.

Does not apply if [split](#tooltip.split) is `true`.

For touch moves to behave the same way, [followTouchMove](#tooltip.followTouchMove) must be `true` also.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-followTouchMove
title: followTouchMove
description:
Whether the tooltip should update as the finger moves on a touch
device. If this is `true` and [chart.panning](#chart.panning) is
set,`followTouchMove` will take over one-finger touches, so the user
needs to use two fingers for zooming and panning.

Note the difference to [followPointer](#tooltip.followPointer) that
only defines the _position_ of the tooltip. If `followPointer` is
false in for example a column series, the tooltip will show above or
below the column, but as `followTouchMove` is true, the tooltip will
jump from column to column as the user swipes across the plot area.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-footerFormat
title: footerFormat
description: A string to append to the tooltip format.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-format
title: format
description:
A [format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
for the whole shared tooltip. When format strings are a requirement,
it is usually more convenient to use `headerFormat`, `pointFormat`
and `footerFormat`, but the `format` option allows combining them
into one setting.

The context of the format string is the same as that of the
`tooltip.formatter` callback.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header
title: header
description:
Options for the tooltip header when [tooltip.split](#tooltip.split)
is enabled. The header is the box containing the X value in a split
tooltip.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description:
Background color for the tooltip header when
[tooltip.split](#tooltip.split) is enabled.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header-borderColor
title: borderColor
description:
Border color for the tooltip header when
[tooltip.split](#tooltip.split) is enabled.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description:
The width of the border for the tooltip header when
[tooltip.split](#tooltip.split) is enabled.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header-distance
title: distance
description:
Distance between the plot area and the header (except the
chevron) in a split tooltip, in pixels. The default value makes
the header text align with the axis labels.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header-shape
title: shape
description:
The name of a symbol to use for the border around the tooltip
header. Applies only when [tooltip.split](#tooltip.split) is
enabled.

Custom callbacks for symbol path generation can also be added to
`Highcharts.SVGRenderer.prototype.symbols` the same way as for
[series.marker.symbol](plotOptions.line.marker.symbol).

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-header-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the tooltip header. The default is `{ fontSize:
'1em' }`, ensuring that the header text is the same size as the
axis labels.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-headerFormat
title: headerFormat
description:
The HTML of the tooltip header line. The context is the
[Point class](https://api.highcharts.com/class-reference/Highcharts.Point).
Variables are enclosed in curly brackets. Examples of common
variables to include are `x`, `y`, `series.name` and `series.color`
and other properties on the same form. The `point.key` variable
contains the category name, x value or datetime string depending on
the type of axis. For datetime axes, the `point.key` date format can
be set using `tooltip.xDateFormat`.
In v12+, locale-aware date names follow the browser's casing and can
be lower-case, so use the `ucfirst` helper (for example
`{ucfirst point.key}`) if you want a capitalized header.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-nullFormat
title: nullFormat
description:
The HTML of the null point's line in the tooltip. Works analogously
to [pointFormat](#tooltip.pointFormat).

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-nullFormatter
title: nullFormatter
description:
Callback function to format the text of the tooltip for
visible null points.
Works analogously to [formatter](#tooltip.formatter), including the
`ctx` callback argument added in v12.5.0.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-pointFormat
title: pointFormat
description:
The HTML of the point's line in the tooltip. The context is the
[Point class](https://api.highcharts.com/class-reference/Highcharts.Point).
Variables are enclosed in curly brackets. Examples of common
variables to include are `x`, `y`, `series.name` and `series.color`
and other properties on the same form. Furthermore, `y` can be
extended by the `tooltip.valuePrefix` and `tooltip.valueSuffix`
variables. This can also be overridden for each series, which makes
it a good hook for displaying units.

In styled mode, the dot is colored by a class name rather than the
point color.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-pointFormatter
title: pointFormatter
description:
A callback function for formatting the HTML output for a single point
in the tooltip. Like the `pointFormat` string, but with more
flexibility. Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the
first argument, so that arrow functions can access the same context
as regular functions using `this`.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-position
title: position
description:
Positioning options for fixed tooltip, taking effect only when
[tooltip.fixed](#tooltip.fixed) is `true`.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-position-align
title: align
description: The horizontal alignment of the fixed tooltip.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-position-relativeTo
title: relativeTo
description:
What the fixed tooltip alignment should be relative to.

The default, `pane`, means that it is aligned within the plot
area for that given series. If the tooltip is split (as default
in Stock charts), each partial tooltip is aligned within the
series' pane.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-position-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description: The vertical alignment of the fixed tooltip.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-position-x
title: x
description:
X pixel offset from the given position. Can be used to shy away
from axis lines, grid lines etc to avoid the tooltip overlapping
other elements.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-position-y
title: y
description:
Y pixel offset from the given position. Can be used to shy away
from axis lines, grid lines etc to avoid the tooltip overlapping
other elements.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-showDelay
title: showDelay
description:
The number of milliseconds to wait until the tooltip is shown when
mouse over a point. Works on initial hover.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-valueDecimals
title: valueDecimals
description:
How many decimals to show in each series' y value. This is
overridable in each series' tooltip options object. The default is to
preserve all decimals.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-valuePrefix
title: valuePrefix
description:
A string to prepend to each series' y value. Overridable in each
series' tooltip options object.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-valueSuffix
title: valueSuffix
description:
A string to append to each series' y value. Overridable in each
series' tooltip options object.

name: plotOptions-series-tooltip-xDateFormat
title: xDateFormat
description:
The format for the date in the tooltip header if the X axis is a
datetime axis. The default is a best guess based on the smallest
distance between points in the chart.

name: plotOptions-series-turboThreshold
title: turboThreshold
description:
When a series contains a `data` array that is longer than this, the
Series class looks for data configurations of plain numbers or arrays of
numbers. The first and last valid points are checked. If found, the rest
of the data is assumed to be the same. This saves expensive data checking
and indexing in long series, and makes data-heavy charts render faster.

Set it to `0` disable.

Note:
- In boost mode turbo threshold is forced. Only array of numbers or two
  dimensional arrays are allowed.
- In version 11.4.3 and earlier, if object configurations were passed
  beyond the turbo threshold, a warning was logged in the console and the
  data series didn't render.

name: plotOptions-series-visible
title: visible
description: Set the initial visibility of the series.

name: plotOptions-series-zoneAxis
title: zoneAxis
description: Defines the Axis on which the zones are applied.

name: plotOptions-series-zones
title: zones
description:
An array defining zones within a series. Zones can be applied to the
X axis, Y axis or Z axis for bubbles, according to the `zoneAxis`
option. The zone definitions have to be in ascending order regarding
to the value.

In styled mode, the color zones are styled with the
`.highcharts-zone-{n}` class, or custom classed from the `className`
option
([view live demo](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/css/color-zones/)).

name: plotOptions-series-zones-className
title: className
description: Styled mode only. A custom class name for the zone.

name: plotOptions-series-zones-color
title: color
description: Defines the color of the series.

name: plotOptions-series-zones-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description: A name for the dash style to use for the graph.

name: plotOptions-series-zones-fillColor
title: fillColor
description: Defines the fill color for the series (in area type series)

name: plotOptions-series-zones-value
title: value
description:
The value up to where the zone extends, if undefined the zones
stretches to the last value in the series.

name: plotOptions-series-zoomEnabled
title: zoomEnabled
description:
Whether to zoom non-cartesian series. If `chart.zooming` is set, the option
allows to disable zooming on an individual non-cartesian series. By default
zooming is enabled for all series.

**Note**: This option works only for non-cartesian series.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge
title: solidgauge

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
The corner radius of the border surrounding solid gauge. A number
signifies pixels and percentage string, like for example `50%`,
signifies a relative size.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-colorByPoint
title: colorByPoint
description: Whether to give each point an individual color.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-innerRadius
title: innerRadius
description:
The inner radius for points in a solid gauge. Can be given either as a
pixel value (number), or as a percentage string, like `"50%"`. Defaults
to match the `pane.innerSize`.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-linecap
title: linecap
description: Whether the strokes of the solid gauge should be `round` or `square`.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-overshoot
title: overshoot
description:
Allow the gauge to overshoot the end of the perimeter axis by this
many degrees. Say if the gauge axis goes from 0 to 60, a value of
100, or 1000, will show 5 degrees beyond the end of the axis when this
option is set to 5.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-radius
title: radius
description:
The outer radius for points in a solid gauge. Can be given either as a
pixel value (number), or as a percentage string, like `"100%"`. Defaults
to match the `pane.size`.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-rounded
title: rounded
description:
Whether to draw rounded edges on the gauge. This options adds the radius
of the rounding to the ends of the arc, so it extends past the actual
values. When `borderRadius` is set, it takes precedence over `rounded`. A
`borderRadius` of 50% behaves like `rounded`, except the shape is not
extended past its value.

name: plotOptions-solidgauge-threshold
title: threshold
description: The threshold or base level for the gauge.

name: plotOptions-spline
title: spline

name: plotOptions-streamgraph
title: streamgraph

name: plotOptions-sunburst
title: sunburst

name: plotOptions-sunburst-allowTraversingTree
title: allowTraversingTree
description:
When enabled the user can click on a point which is a parent and
zoom in on its children.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs
title: breadcrumbs
description:
Options for the breadcrumbs, the navigation at the top leading the
way up through the traversed levels.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-buttonSpacing
title: buttonSpacing
description: The default padding for each button and separator in each direction.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-buttonTheme
title: buttonTheme
description:
A collection of attributes for the buttons. The object takes SVG
attributes like `fill`, `stroke`, `stroke-width`, as well as `style`,
a collection of CSS properties for the text.

The object can also be extended with states, so you can set
presentational options for `hover`, `select` or `disabled` button
states.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-events-click
title: click

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-floating
title: floating
description:
When the breadcrumbs are floating, the plot area will not move to
make space for it. By default, the chart will not make space for the
buttons. This property won't work when positioned in the middle.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the breadcrumbs button. Variables are enclosed by
curly brackets. Available values are passed in the declared point
options.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-formatter
title: formatter
description: Callback function to format the breadcrumb text from scratch.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-position
title: position
description:
Positioning for the button row. The breadcrumbs buttons will be
aligned properly for the default chart layout (title,  subtitle,
legend, range selector) for the custom chart layout set the position
properties.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-position-align
title: align
description: Horizontal alignment of the breadcrumbs buttons.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-position-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description: Vertical alignment of the breadcrumbs buttons.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-position-x
title: x
description: The X offset of the breadcrumbs button group.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-position-y
title: y
description:
The Y offset of the breadcrumbs button group. When `undefined`,
and `floating` is `false`, the `y` position is adapted so that
the breadcrumbs are rendered outside the target area.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-relativeTo
title: relativeTo
description:
What box to align the button to. Can be either `plotBox` or
`spacingBox`.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-rtl
title: rtl
description:
Whether to reverse the order of buttons. This is common in Arabic
and Hebrew.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-separator
title: separator
description: Options object for Breadcrumbs separator.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-separator-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the breadcrumbs separator.

In styled mode, the breadcrumbs separators are styled by the
`.highcharts-separator` rule with its different states.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-showFullPath
title: showFullPath
description: Show full path or only a single button.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for all breadcrumbs.

In styled mode, the breadcrumbs buttons are styled by the
`.highcharts-breadcrumbs-buttons .highcharts-button` rule with its
different states.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-useHTML
title: useHTML
description: Whether to use HTML to render the breadcrumbs items texts.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-breadcrumbs-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The z index of the breadcrumbs group.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-center
title: center
description:
The center of the sunburst chart relative to the plot area. Can be
percentages or pixel values.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-dataLabels-rotationMode
title: rotationMode
description:
Decides how the data label will be rotated relative to the
perimeter of the sunburst. Valid values are `circular`, `auto`,
`parallel` and `perpendicular`. When `circular`, the best fit
will be computed for the point, so that the label is curved
around the center when there is room for it, otherwise
perpendicular. The legacy `auto` option works similar to
`circular`, but instead of curving the labels they are tangent to
the perimeter.

The `rotation` option takes precedence over `rotationMode`.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levelIsConstant
title: levelIsConstant
description:
Used together with the levels and `allowDrillToNode` options. When
set to false the first level visible when drilling is considered
to be level one. Otherwise the level will be the same as the tree
structure.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levelSize
title: levelSize
description: Determines the width of the ring per level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levelSize-unit
title: unit
description:
How to interpret `levelSize.value`.

- `percentage` gives a width relative to result of outer radius
  minus inner radius.

- `pixels` gives the ring a fixed width in pixels.

- `weight` takes the remaining width after percentage and pixels,
  and distributes it across all "weighted" levels. The value
  relative to the sum of all weights determines the width.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levelSize-value
title: value
description:
The value used for calculating the width of the ring. Its' affect
is determined by `levelSize.unit`.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels
title: levels
description:
Set options on specific levels. Takes precedence over series options,
but not point options.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: Can set a `borderColor` on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-borderDashStyle
title: borderDashStyle
description:
Can set a `borderDashStyle` on all points which lies on the same
level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: Can set a `borderWidth` on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-color
title: color
description: Can set a `color` on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-colorByPoint
title: colorByPoint
description:
Determines whether the chart should receive one color per point based
on this level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-colorVariation
title: colorVariation
description:
Can set a `colorVariation` on all points which lies on the same
level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-colorVariation-key
title: key
description: The key of a color variation. Currently supports `brightness` only.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-colorVariation-to
title: to
description:
The ending value of a color variation. The last sibling will receive
this value.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description: Can set `dataLabels` on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-level
title: level
description:
Decides which level takes effect from the options set in the levels
object.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-levelIsConstant
title: levelIsConstant
description:
Whether the `level` number is absolute, or relative to the currently
visible root. Overrides the series option of the same name for this
level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-levels-levelSize
title: levelSize
description: Can set a `levelSize` on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-rootId
title: rootId
description: Which point to use as a root in the visualization.

name: plotOptions-sunburst-slicedOffset
title: slicedOffset
description:
If a point is sliced, moved out from the center, how many pixels
should it be moved?.

name: plotOptions-tilemap
title: tilemap

name: plotOptions-tilemap-colsize
title: colsize
description:
The column size - how many X axis units each column in the tilemap
should span. Works as in [Heatmaps](#plotOptions.heatmap.colsize).

name: plotOptions-tilemap-pointPadding
title: pointPadding
description: The padding between points in the tilemap.

name: plotOptions-tilemap-rowsize
title: rowsize
description:
The row size - how many Y axis units each tilemap row should span.
Analogous to [colsize](#plotOptions.tilemap.colsize).

name: plotOptions-tilemap-tileShape
title: tileShape
description:
The shape of the tiles in the tilemap. Possible values are `hexagon`,
`circle`, `diamond`, and `square`.

name: plotOptions-timeline
title: timeline

name: plotOptions-timeline-dataLabels-alternate
title: alternate
description:
Whether to position data labels alternately. For example, if
[distance](#plotOptions.timeline.dataLabels.distance)
is set equal to `100`, then data labels will be positioned
alternately (on both sides of the point) at a distance of 100px.

name: plotOptions-timeline-dataLabels-connectorColor
title: connectorColor
description:
The color of the line connecting the data label to the point.
The default color is the same as the point's color.

In styled mode, the connector stroke is given in the
`.highcharts-data-label-connector` class.

name: plotOptions-timeline-dataLabels-connectorWidth
title: connectorWidth
description:
The width of the line connecting the data label to the point.

In styled mode, the connector stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-data-label-connector` class.

name: plotOptions-timeline-dataLabels-distance
title: distance
description:
A pixel value defining the distance between the data label and
the point. Negative numbers puts the label on top of the point in a
non-inverted chart. Defaults to 100 for horizontal and 20 for
vertical timeline (`chart.inverted: true`).

name: plotOptions-timeline-dataLabels-shadow
title: shadow
description: Shadow options for the data label.

name: plotOptions-timeline-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: Pixel width of the graph line.

name: plotOptions-treegraph
title: treegraph

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton
title: collapseButton
description:
Options applied to collapse Button. The collapse button is the
small button which indicates, that the node is collapsable.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-enabled
title: enabled
description: Whether the button should be visible.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-height
title: height
description: Height of the button.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The line width of the button in pixels

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-onlyOnHover
title: onlyOnHover
description:
Whether the button should be visible only when the node is
hovered. When set to true, the button is hidden for nodes,
which are not collapsed, and shown for the collapsed ones.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-shape
title: shape
description: The symbol of the collapse button.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the collapse button.

In styled mode, the collapse button style is given in the
`.highcharts-collapse-button` class.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-width
title: width
description: Width of the button.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-x
title: x
description: Offset of the button in the x direction.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-collapseButton-y
title: y
description: Offset of the button in the y direction.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description:
Options for the data labels appearing on top of the nodes and
links. For treegraph charts, data labels are visible for the
nodes by default, but hidden for links. This is controlled by
modifying the `nodeFormat`, and the `format` that applies to
links and is an empty string by default.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-dataLabels-linkTextPath
title: linkTextPath
description:
Options for a _link_ label text which should follow link
connection. Border and background are disabled for a label
that follows a path.

**Note:** Only SVG-based renderer supports this option.
Setting `useHTML` to true will disable this option.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-dataLabels-pointFormat
title: pointFormat
description:
The
[format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
specifying what to show for _nodes_ in the treegraph. Overrides
`format`. Use `pointFormat` and `linkFormat` to differentiate between
node and link data labels.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-fillSpace
title: fillSpace
description:
Whether the treegraph series should fill the entire plot area in the X
axis direction, even when there are collapsed points.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-levels-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description:
Can set the options of dataLabels on each point which lies on the
level.
[plotOptions.treegraph.dataLabels](#plotOptions.treegraph.dataLabels)
for possible values.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-link-bendAt
title: bendAt
description:
For the orthogonal link type, this defines how far down the link
bends. A number defines the pixel offset from the start of the link,
and a percentage defines the relative position on the link. For
example, a `bendAt` of `50%` means that the link bends in the middle.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-link-color
title: color
description: The color of the links between nodes.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-link-curveFactor
title: curveFactor
description:
Modifier of the shape of the curved link. Works best for
values between 0 and 1, where 0 is a straight line, and 1 is
a shape close to the default one.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-link-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The line width of the links connecting nodes, in pixels.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-link-radius
title: radius
description:
Radius for the rounded corners of the links between nodes.
Works for the `orthogonal` link type.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-link-type
title: type
description: Type of the link shape.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-nodeDistance
title: nodeDistance
description:
The distance between nodes in a tree graph in the longitudinal direction.
The longitudinal direction means the direction that the chart flows - in
a horizontal chart the distance is horizontal, in an inverted chart
(vertical), the distance is vertical.

If a number is given, it denotes pixels. If a percentage string is given,
the distance is a percentage of the rendered node width. A `nodeDistance`
of `100%` will render equal widths for the nodes and the gaps between
them.

This option applies only when the `nodeWidth` option is `auto`, making
the node width respond to the number of columns.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-nodeWidth
title: nodeWidth
description:
The pixel width of each node in a, or the height in case the chart is
inverted. For tree graphs, the node width is only applied if the marker
symbol is `rect`, otherwise the `marker` sizing options apply.

Can be a number or a percentage string, or `auto`. If `auto`, the nodes
are sized to fill up the plot area in the longitudinal direction,
regardless of the number of levels.

name: plotOptions-treegraph-reversed
title: reversed
description:
Flips the positions of the nodes of a treegraph along the
horizontal axis (vertical if chart is inverted).

name: plotOptions-treegraph-tooltip-linkFormat
title: linkFormat
description:
The HTML of the point's line in the tooltip. Variables are enclosed
by curly brackets. Available variables are `point.id`,
`point.fromNode.id`, `point.toNode.id`, `series.name`, `series.color`
and other properties on the same form. Furthermore, This can also be
overridden for each series, which makes it a good hook for displaying
units. In styled mode, the dot is colored by a class name rather than
the point color.

name: plotOptions-treemap
title: treemap

name: plotOptions-treemap-allowTraversingTree
title: allowTraversingTree
description:
When enabled the user can click on a point which is a parent and
zoom in on its children.

name: plotOptions-treemap-alternateStartingDirection
title: alternateStartingDirection
description:
Enabling this option will make the treemap alternate the drawing
direction between vertical and horizontal. The next levels starting
direction will always be the opposite of the previous.

name: plotOptions-treemap-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The color of the border surrounding each tree map item.

name: plotOptions-treemap-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: The border radius for each treemap item.

name: plotOptions-treemap-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The width of the border surrounding each tree map item.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs
title: breadcrumbs
description:
Options for the breadcrumbs, the navigation at the top leading the
way up through the traversed levels.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-buttonSpacing
title: buttonSpacing
description: The default padding for each button and separator in each direction.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-buttonTheme
title: buttonTheme
description:
A collection of attributes for the buttons. The object takes SVG
attributes like `fill`, `stroke`, `stroke-width`, as well as `style`,
a collection of CSS properties for the text.

The object can also be extended with states, so you can set
presentational options for `hover`, `select` or `disabled` button
states.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-events-click
title: click

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-floating
title: floating
description:
When the breadcrumbs are floating, the plot area will not move to
make space for it. By default, the chart will not make space for the
buttons. This property won't work when positioned in the middle.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the breadcrumbs button. Variables are enclosed by
curly brackets. Available values are passed in the declared point
options.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-formatter
title: formatter
description: Callback function to format the breadcrumb text from scratch.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-position
title: position
description:
Positioning for the button row. The breadcrumbs buttons will be
aligned properly for the default chart layout (title,  subtitle,
legend, range selector) for the custom chart layout set the position
properties.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-position-align
title: align
description: Horizontal alignment of the breadcrumbs buttons.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-position-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description: Vertical alignment of the breadcrumbs buttons.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-position-x
title: x
description: The X offset of the breadcrumbs button group.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-position-y
title: y
description:
The Y offset of the breadcrumbs button group. When `undefined`,
and `floating` is `false`, the `y` position is adapted so that
the breadcrumbs are rendered outside the target area.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-relativeTo
title: relativeTo
description:
What box to align the button to. Can be either `plotBox` or
`spacingBox`.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-rtl
title: rtl
description:
Whether to reverse the order of buttons. This is common in Arabic
and Hebrew.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-separator
title: separator
description: Options object for Breadcrumbs separator.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-separator-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the breadcrumbs separator.

In styled mode, the breadcrumbs separators are styled by the
`.highcharts-separator` rule with its different states.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-showFullPath
title: showFullPath
description: Show full path or only a single button.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for all breadcrumbs.

In styled mode, the breadcrumbs buttons are styled by the
`.highcharts-breadcrumbs-buttons .highcharts-button` rule with its
different states.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-useHTML
title: useHTML
description: Whether to use HTML to render the breadcrumbs items texts.

name: plotOptions-treemap-breadcrumbs-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The z index of the breadcrumbs group.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster
title: cluster
description:
An option to optimize treemap series rendering by grouping smaller leaf
nodes below a certain square area threshold in pixels. If the square area
of a point becomes smaller than the specified threshold, determined by
the `pixelWidth` and/or `pixelHeight` options, then this point is moved
into one group point per series.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-className
title: className
description:
An additional, individual class name for the grouped point's graphic
representation.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-color
title: color
description:
Individual color for the grouped point. By default the color is
pulled from the parent color.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable Treemap grouping.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-minimumClusterSize
title: minimumClusterSize
description:
Defines the minimum number of child nodes required to create a group
of small nodes.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-name
title: name
description:
The name of the point of grouped nodes shown in the tooltip,
dataLabels, etc. By default it is set to '+ n', where n is number of
grouped points.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-pixelHeight
title: pixelHeight
description:
The pixel threshold height of area, which is used in Treemap
grouping.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-pixelWidth
title: pixelWidth
description: The pixel threshold width of area, which is used in Treemap grouping.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cluster-reductionFactor
title: reductionFactor
description:
A configuration property that specifies the factor by which the value
and size of a grouped node are reduced. This can be particularly
useful when a grouped node occupies a disproportionately large
portion of the graph, ensuring better visual balance and readability.

name: plotOptions-treemap-colorByPoint
title: colorByPoint
description:
When using automatic point colors pulled from the `options.colors`
collection, this option determines whether the chart should receive
one color per series or one color per point.

name: plotOptions-treemap-colors
title: colors
description:
A series specific or series type specific color set to apply instead
of the global [colors](#colors) when
[colorByPoint](#plotOptions.treemap.colorByPoint) is true.

name: plotOptions-treemap-cropThreshold
title: cropThreshold
description:
When the series contains less points than the crop threshold, all
points are drawn, even if the points fall outside the visible plot
area at the current zoom. The advantage of drawing all points
(including markers and columns), is that animation is performed on
updates. On the other hand, when the series contains more points than
the crop threshold, the series data is cropped to only contain points
that fall within the plot area. The advantage of cropping away
invisible points is to increase performance on large series.

name: plotOptions-treemap-dataLabels-headers
title: headers
description:
Whether the data label should act as a group-level header. For leaf
nodes, headers are not supported and the data label will be rendered
inside.

name: plotOptions-treemap-events-setRootNode
title: setRootNode
description:
Fires on a request for change of root node for the tree, before the
update is made. An event object is passed to the function, containing
additional properties `newRootId`, `previousRootId`, `redraw` and
`trigger`.

name: plotOptions-treemap-groupPadding
title: groupPadding
description:
Group padding for parent elements in terms of pixels. See also the
`nodeSizeBy` option that controls how the leaf nodes' size is affected by
the padding.

name: plotOptions-treemap-ignoreHiddenPoint
title: ignoreHiddenPoint
description:
Whether to ignore hidden points when the layout algorithm runs.
If `false`, hidden points will leave open spaces.

name: plotOptions-treemap-interactByLeaf
title: interactByLeaf
description:
This option decides if the user can interact with the parent nodes
or just the leaf nodes. When this option is undefined, it will be
true by default. However when allowTraversingTree is true, then it
will be false by default.

name: plotOptions-treemap-layoutAlgorithm
title: layoutAlgorithm
description:
This option decides which algorithm is used for setting position
and dimensions of the points.

name: plotOptions-treemap-layoutStartingDirection
title: layoutStartingDirection
description: Defines which direction the layout algorithm will start drawing.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levelIsConstant
title: levelIsConstant
description:
Used together with the levels and allowTraversingTree options. When
set to false the first level visible to be level one, which is
dynamic when traversing the tree. Otherwise the level will be the
same as the tree structure.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels
title: levels
description:
Set options on specific levels. Takes precedence over series options,
but not point options.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: Can set a `borderColor` on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-borderDashStyle
title: borderDashStyle
description:
Set the dash style of the border of all the point which lies on the
level. See
[plotOptions.scatter.dashStyle](#plotoptions.scatter.dashstyle)
for possible options.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: Can set the borderWidth on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-color
title: color
description: Can set a color on all points which lies on the same level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-colorVariation
title: colorVariation
description:
A configuration object to define how the color of a child varies from
the parent's color. The variation is distributed among the children
of node. For example when setting brightness, the brightness change
will range from the parent's original brightness on the first child,
to the amount set in the `to` setting on the last node. This allows a
gradient-like color scheme that sets children out from each other
while highlighting the grouping on treemaps and sectors on sunburst
charts.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-colorVariation-key
title: key
description: The key of a color variation. Currently supports `brightness` only.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-colorVariation-to
title: to
description:
The ending value of a color variation. The last sibling will receive
this value.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description:
Can set the options of dataLabels on each point which lies on the
level.
[plotOptions.treemap.dataLabels](#plotOptions.treemap.dataLabels) for
possible values.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-groupPadding
title: groupPadding
description:
Can set the group padding on a specific level. Overrides the series
option of the same name.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-layoutAlgorithm
title: layoutAlgorithm
description: Can set the layoutAlgorithm option on a specific level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-layoutStartingDirection
title: layoutStartingDirection
description: Can set the layoutStartingDirection option on a specific level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-level
title: level
description:
Decides which level takes effect from the options set in the levels
object.

name: plotOptions-treemap-levels-levelIsConstant
title: levelIsConstant
description:
Whether the `level` number is absolute, or relative to the currently
visible root. Overrides the series option of the same name for this
level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-nodeSizeBy
title: nodeSizeBy
description:
Experimental. How to set the size of child nodes when a header or padding
is present. When `leaf`, the group is expanded to make room for headers
and padding in order to preserve the relative sizes between leaves. When
`group`, the leaves are naïvely fit into the remaining area after the
header and padding are subtracted.

name: plotOptions-treemap-opacity
title: opacity
description:
The opacity of grouped points in treemap. When a point has children, the
group point is covering the children, and is given this opacity. The
visibility of the children is determined by the opacity.

name: plotOptions-treemap-showInLegend
title: showInLegend
description:
Whether to display this series type or specific series item in the
legend.

name: plotOptions-treemap-sortIndex
title: sortIndex
description: The sort index of the point inside the treemap level.

name: plotOptions-treemap-states
title: states
description: A wrapper object for all the series options in specific states.

name: plotOptions-treemap-states-hover
title: hover
description: Options for the hovered series

name: plotOptions-treemap-states-hover-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The border color for the hovered state.

name: plotOptions-treemap-states-hover-brightness
title: brightness
description:
Brightness for the hovered point. Defaults to 0 if the
heatmap series is loaded first, otherwise 0.1.

name: plotOptions-treemap-states-hover-opacity
title: opacity
description:
The opacity of a point in treemap. When a point has children,
the visibility of the children is determined by the opacity.

name: plotOptions-treemap-states-hover-shadow
title: shadow
description: The shadow option for hovered state.

name: plotOptions-treemap-traverseToLeaf
title: traverseToLeaf
description:
This option enables automatic traversing to the last child level upon
node interaction. This feature simplifies navigation by immediately
focusing on the deepest layer of the data structure without intermediate
steps.

name: plotOptions-variablepie
title: variablepie

name: plotOptions-variablepie-maxPointSize
title: maxPointSize
description:
The maximum size of the points' radius related to chart's `plotArea`.
If a number is set, it applies in pixels.

name: plotOptions-variablepie-minPointSize
title: minPointSize
description:
The minimum size of the points' radius related to chart's `plotArea`.
If a number is set, it applies in pixels.

name: plotOptions-variablepie-sizeBy
title: sizeBy
description:
Whether the pie slice's value should be represented by the area or
the radius of the slice. Can be either `area` or `radius`. The
default, `area`, corresponds best to the human perception of the size
of each pie slice.

name: plotOptions-variablepie-zMax
title: zMax
description:
The maximum possible z value for the point's radius calculation. If
the point's Z value is bigger than zMax, the slice will be drawn
according to the zMax value

name: plotOptions-variablepie-zMin
title: zMin
description:
The minimum possible z value for the point's radius calculation. If
the point's Z value is smaller than zMin, the slice will be drawn
according to the zMin value.

name: plotOptions-variwide
title: variwide

name: plotOptions-variwide-groupPadding
title: groupPadding
description:
In a variwide chart, the group padding is 0 in order to express the
horizontal stacking of items.

name: plotOptions-variwide-pointPadding
title: pointPadding
description:
In a variwide chart, the point padding is 0 in order to express the
horizontal stacking of items.

name: plotOptions-vector
title: vector

name: plotOptions-vector-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The line width for each vector arrow.

name: plotOptions-vector-rotationOrigin
title: rotationOrigin
description:
What part of the vector it should be rotated around. Can be one of
`start`, `center` and `end`. When `start`, the vectors will start
from the given [x, y] position, and when `end` the vectors will end
in the [x, y] position.

name: plotOptions-vector-states-hover-lineWidthPlus
title: lineWidthPlus
description:
Additional line width for the vector errors when they are
hovered.

name: plotOptions-vector-vectorLength
title: vectorLength
description:
Maximum length of the arrows in the vector plot. The individual arrow
length is computed between 0 and this value.

name: plotOptions-venn
title: venn

name: plotOptions-waterfall
title: waterfall

name: plotOptions-waterfall-borderColor
title: borderColor
description:
The color of the border of each waterfall column.

In styled mode, the border stroke can be set with the
`.highcharts-point` class.

name: plotOptions-waterfall-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description:
A name for the dash style to use for the line connecting the columns
of the waterfall series. Possible values: Dash, DashDot, Dot,
LongDash, LongDashDot, LongDashDotDot, ShortDash, ShortDashDot,
ShortDashDotDot, ShortDot, Solid

In styled mode, the stroke dash-array can be set with the
`.highcharts-graph` class.

name: plotOptions-waterfall-lineColor
title: lineColor
description:
The color of the line that connects columns in a waterfall series.

In styled mode, the stroke can be set with the `.highcharts-graph`
class.

name: plotOptions-waterfall-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The width of the line connecting waterfall columns.

name: plotOptions-waterfall-upColor
title: upColor
description:
The color used specifically for positive point columns. When not
specified, the general series color is used.

In styled mode, the waterfall colors can be set with the
`.highcharts-point-negative`, `.highcharts-sum` and
`.highcharts-intermediate-sum` classes.

name: plotOptions-windbarb
title: windbarb

name: plotOptions-windbarb-dataGrouping
title: dataGrouping
description:
Data grouping options for the wind barbs. In Highcharts, this
requires the `modules/datagrouping.js` module to be loaded. In
Highcharts Stock, data grouping is included.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-dataGrouping-approximation
title: approximation
description:
Approximation function for the data grouping. The default
returns an average of wind speed and a vector average direction
weighted by wind speed.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-dataGrouping-enabled
title: enabled
description: Whether to enable data grouping.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-dataGrouping-groupPixelWidth
title: groupPixelWidth
description: The approximate data group width.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The line width of the wind barb symbols.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-onSeries
title: onSeries
description:
The id of another series in the chart that the wind barbs are
projected on. When `null`, the wind symbols are drawn on the X axis,
but offset up or down by the `yOffset` setting.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-tooltip-pointFormat
title: pointFormat
description:
The default point format for the wind barb tooltip. Note the
`point.beaufort` property that refers to the Beaufort wind scale.
The names can be internationalized by modifying
`Highcharts.seriesTypes.windbarb.prototype.beaufortNames`.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-vectorLength
title: vectorLength
description: Pixel length of the stems.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-xOffset
title: xOffset
description:
Horizontal offset from the cartesian position, in pixels. When the
chart is inverted, this option allows translation like
[yOffset](#plotOptions.windbarb.yOffset) in non inverted charts.

name: plotOptions-windbarb-yOffset
title: yOffset
description:
Vertical offset from the cartesian position, in pixels. The default
value makes sure the symbols don't overlap the X axis when `onSeries`
is `null`, and that they don't overlap the linked series when
`onSeries` is given.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud
title: wordcloud

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-maxFontSize
title: maxFontSize
description:
The word with the largest weight will have a font size equal to this
value. The font size of a word is the ratio between its weight and
the largest occurring weight, multiplied with the value of
maxFontSize.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-minFontSize
title: minFontSize
description:
A threshold determining the minimum font size that can be applied to
a word.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-placementStrategy
title: placementStrategy
description:
This option decides which algorithm is used for placement, and
rotation of a word. The choice of algorithm is therefore a crucial
part of the resulting layout of the wordcloud. It is possible for
users to add their own custom placement strategies for use in word
cloud. Read more about it in our
[documentation](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-and-series-types/word-cloud-series#custom-placement-strategies)

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-rotation
title: rotation
description: Rotation options for the words in the wordcloud.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-rotation-from
title: from
description: The smallest degree of rotation for a word.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-rotation-orientations
title: orientations
description:
The number of possible orientations for a word, within the range
of `rotation.from` and `rotation.to`. Must be a number larger
than 0.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-rotation-to
title: to
description: The largest degree of rotation for a word.

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-spiral
title: spiral
description:
Spiral used for placing a word after the initial position
experienced a collision with either another word or the borders.
It is possible for users to add their own custom spiralling
algorithms for use in word cloud. Read more about it in our
[documentation](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-and-series-types/word-cloud-series#custom-spiralling-algorithm)

name: plotOptions-wordcloud-style
title: style
description: CSS styles for the words.

name: plotOptions-xrange
title: xrange

name: plotOptions-xrange-colorByPoint
title: colorByPoint
description:
In an X-range series, this option makes all points of the same Y-axis
category the same color.

name: plotOptions-xrange-dragDrop-draggableX1
title: draggableX1
description: Allow x value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-xrange-dragDrop-draggableX2
title: draggableX2
description: Allow x2 value to be dragged individually.

name: plotOptions-xrange-partialFill
title: partialFill
description:
A partial fill for each point, typically used to visualize how much
of a task is performed. The partial fill object can be set either on
series or point level. When set as a number, works as
`{ amount: number }`.

name: plotOptions-xrange-partialFill-fill
title: fill
description:
The fill color to be used for partial fills. Defaults to a darker
shade of the point color.

name: responsive
title: responsive
description:
Allows setting a set of rules to apply for different screen or chart
sizes. Each rule specifies additional chart options.

name: responsive-rules
title: rules
description:
A set of rules for responsive settings. The rules are executed from
the top down.

name: responsive-rules-chartOptions
title: chartOptions
description:
A full set of chart options to apply as overrides to the general
chart options. The chart options are applied when the given rule
is active.

A special case is configuration objects that take arrays, for example
[xAxis](#xAxis), [yAxis](#yAxis) or [series](#series). For these
collections, an `id` option is used to map the new option set to
an existing object. If an existing object of the same id is not found,
the item of the same index updated. So for example, setting `chartOptions`
with two series items without an `id`, will cause the existing chart's
two series to be updated with respective options.

name: responsive-rules-condition
title: condition
description: Under which conditions the rule applies.

name: responsive-rules-condition-callback
title: callback
description:
A callback function to gain complete control on when the responsive
rule applies. Return `true` if it applies. This opens for checking
against other metrics than the chart size, for example the document
size or other elements. Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx`
as the first argument, so that arrow functions can access the same
context as regular functions using `this`.

name: responsive-rules-condition-maxHeight
title: maxHeight
description: The responsive rule applies if the chart height is less than this.

name: responsive-rules-condition-maxWidth
title: maxWidth
description: The responsive rule applies if the chart width is less than this.

name: responsive-rules-condition-minHeight
title: minHeight
description: The responsive rule applies if the chart height is greater than this.

name: responsive-rules-condition-minWidth
title: minWidth
description: The responsive rule applies if the chart width is greater than this.

name: series
title: series

name: series-accessibility
title: accessibility
description: Accessibility options for a series.

name: series-accessibility-description
title: description
description: Provide a description of the series, announced to screen readers.

name: series-accessibility-descriptionFormat
title: descriptionFormat
description:
Format to use for describing the data series group to assistive
technology - including screen readers.

name: series-accessibility-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable/disable accessibility functionality for a specific series.

name: series-accessibility-exposeAsGroupOnly
title: exposeAsGroupOnly
description: Expose only the series element to screen readers, not its points.

name: series-accessibility-keyboardNavigation
title: keyboardNavigation
description: Keyboard navigation for a series

name: series-accessibility-keyboardNavigation-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable/disable keyboard navigation support for a specific series.

name: series-accessibility-point
title: point
description: Point accessibility options for a series.

name: series-accessibility-point-dateFormat
title: dateFormat
description:
Date format to use for points on datetime axes when describing
them to screen reader users.

Defaults to the same format as in tooltip.

For an overview of the replacement codes, see
[dateFormat](/class-reference/Highcharts.Time#dateFormat).

name: series-accessibility-point-dateFormatter
title: dateFormatter
description:
Formatter function to determine the date/time format used with
points on datetime axes when describing them to screen reader
users. Receives one argument, `point`, referring to the point
to describe. Should return a date format string compatible with
[dateFormat](/class-reference/Highcharts.Time#dateFormat).

name: series-accessibility-point-describeNull
title: describeNull
description:
Whether or not to describe points with the value `null` to
assistive technology, such as screen readers.

name: series-accessibility-point-descriptionFormat
title: descriptionFormat
description:
A [format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
to use instead of the default for point descriptions.

The context of the format string is the point instance.

As opposed to [accessibility.point.valueDescriptionFormat](#accessibility.point.valueDescriptionFormat),
this option replaces the whole description.

name: series-accessibility-point-descriptionFormatter
title: descriptionFormatter
description:
Formatter function to use instead of the default for point
descriptions. Same as `accessibility.point.descriptionFormatter`, but
applies to a series instead of the whole chart.

Note: Prefer using [accessibility.point.valueDescriptionFormat](#plotOptions.series.accessibility.point.valueDescriptionFormat)
instead if possible, as default functionality such as describing
annotations will be preserved.

name: series-accessibility-point-valueDecimals
title: valueDecimals
description:
Decimals to use for the values in the point descriptions. Uses
[tooltip.valueDecimals](#tooltip.valueDecimals) if not defined.

name: series-accessibility-point-valueDescriptionFormat
title: valueDescriptionFormat
description:
Format to use for describing the values of data points
to assistive technology - including screen readers.
The point context is available as `{point}`.

Other available context variables include `{index}`, `{value}`, and `{xDescription}`.

Additionally, the series name, annotation info, and
description added in `point.accessibility.description`
is added by default if relevant. To override this, use the
[accessibility.point.descriptionFormatter](#accessibility.point.descriptionFormatter)
option.

name: series-accessibility-point-valuePrefix
title: valuePrefix
description:
Prefix to add to the values in the point descriptions. Uses
[tooltip.valuePrefix](#tooltip.valuePrefix) if not defined.

name: series-accessibility-point-valueSuffix
title: valueSuffix
description:
Suffix to add to the values in the point descriptions. Uses
[tooltip.valueSuffix](#tooltip.valueSuffix) if not defined.

name: series-allowPointSelect
title: allowPointSelect
description:
Allow this series' points to be selected by clicking on the graphic
(columns, point markers, pie slices, map areas etc).

The selected points can be handled by point select and unselect
events, or collectively by the [getSelectedPoints](/class-reference/Highcharts.Chart#getSelectedPoints) function.

And alternative way of selecting points is through dragging.

name: series-animation
title: animation
description:
Enable or disable the initial animation when a series is displayed.
The animation can also be set as a configuration object. Please
note that this option only applies to the initial animation of the
series itself. For other animations, see [chart.animation](#chart.animation) and the animation parameter under the API methods.
The following properties are supported:

- `defer`: The animation delay time in milliseconds.

- `duration`: The duration of the animation in milliseconds. (Defaults to
  `1000`)

- `easing`: Can be a string reference to an easing function set on
  the `Math` object or a function. See the _Custom easing function_
  demo below. (Defaults to `easeInOutSine`)

Due to poor performance, animation is disabled in old IE browsers
for several chart types.

name: series-animationLimit
title: animationLimit
description:
For some series, there is a limit that shuts down animation
by default when the total number of points in the chart is too high.
For example, for a column chart and its derivatives, animation does
not run if there is more than 250 points totally. To disable this
cap, set `animationLimit` to `Infinity`. This option works if animation
is fired on individual points, not on a group of points like e.g. during
the initial animation.

name: series-boostBlending
title: boostBlending
description: Sets the color blending in the boost module.

name: series-boostThreshold
title: boostThreshold
description:
Set the point threshold for when a series should enter boost mode.

Setting it to e.g. 2000 will cause the series to enter boost mode when there
are 2000 or more points in the series.

To disable boosting on the series, set the `boostThreshold` to 0. Setting it
to 1 will force boosting.

Note that the [cropThreshold](plotOptions.series.cropThreshold) also affects
this setting. When zooming in on a series that has fewer points than the
`cropThreshold`, all points are rendered although outside the visible plot
area, and the `boostThreshold` won't take effect.

name: series-className
title: className
description:
An additional class name to apply to the series' graphical elements.
This option does not replace default class names of the graphical
element. Changes to the series' color will also be reflected in a
chart's legend and tooltip.

name: series-clip
title: clip
description:
Disable this option to allow series rendering in the whole plotting
area.

**Note:** Clipping should be always enabled when
[chart.zoomType](#chart.zoomType) is set

name: series-color
title: color
description:
The main color of the series. In line type series it applies to the
line and the point markers unless otherwise specified. In bar type
series it applies to the bars unless a color is specified per point.
The default value is pulled from the `options.colors` array.

In styled mode, the color can be defined by the
[colorIndex](#plotOptions.series.colorIndex) option. Also, the series
color can be set with the `.highcharts-series`,
`.highcharts-color-{n}`, `.highcharts-{type}-series` or
`.highcharts-series-{n}` class, or individual classes given by the
`className` option.

name: series-colorAxis
title: colorAxis
description:
When using dual or multiple color axes, this number defines which
colorAxis the particular series is connected to. It refers to
either the
{@link #colorAxis.id|axis id}
or the index of the axis in the colorAxis array, with 0 being the
first. Set this option to false to prevent a series from connecting
to the default color axis.

Since v7.2.0 the option can also be an axis id or an axis index
instead of a boolean flag.

name: series-colorIndex
title: colorIndex
description:
Styled mode only. A specific color index to use for the series, so its
graphic representations are given the class name `highcharts-color-{n}`.

Since v11, CSS variables on the form `--highcharts-color-{n}` make
changing the color scheme very convenient.

name: series-colorKey
title: colorKey
description:
Determines what data value should be used to calculate point color
if `colorAxis` is used. Requires to set `min` and `max` if some
custom point property is used or if approximation for data grouping
is set to `'sum'`.

name: series-connectEnds
title: connectEnds
description:
Polar charts only. Whether to connect the ends of a line series
plot across the extremes.

name: series-connectNulls
title: connectNulls
description:
Whether to connect a graph line across null points, or render a gap
between the two points on either side of the null.

In stacked area chart, if `connectNulls` is set to true,
