name: yAxis-minorTickWidth
title: minorTickWidth
description: The pixel width of the minor tick mark.

name: yAxis-minorTicks
title: minorTicks
description:
Enable or disable minor ticks. The interval between the minor ticks
can be controlled either by the
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor) setting, or as an
absolute [minorTickInterval](#xAxis.minorTickInterval) value.

On a logarithmic axis, minor ticks are laid out based on a best
guess, attempting to enter an approximate number of minor ticks
between each major tick based on
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor).

Prior to v6.0.0, ticks were enabled in auto layout by setting
`minorTickInterval` to `"auto"`.

name: yAxis-minorTicksPerMajor
title: minorTicksPerMajor
description:
The number of minor ticks per major tick. Works for `linear`,
`logarithmic` and `datetime` axes.

For radial axes in gauges, the default value is 10.

name: yAxis-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance in pixels from the plot area to the axis line.
A positive offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks
away from the plot area. This is typically used when two or more
axes are displayed on the same side of the plot. With multiple
axes the offset is dynamically adjusted to avoid collision, this
can be overridden by setting offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string, and
defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the pane and
plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the offset in
radial axes.

name: yAxis-pane
title: pane
description:
Refers to the index in the [panes](#panes) array. Used for circular
gauges and polar charts. When the option is not set then first pane
will be used.

name: yAxis-panningEnabled
title: panningEnabled
description:
Whether to pan axis. If `chart.panning` is enabled, the option
allows to disable panning on an individual axis.

name: yAxis-plotBands-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: Border color for the plot band. Also requires `borderWidth` to be set.

name: yAxis-plotBands-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
Border radius for the plot band. Applies only to gauges. Can be a pixel
value or a percentage, for example `50%`.

name: yAxis-plotBands-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: Border width for the plot band. Also requires `borderColor` to be set.

name: yAxis-plotBands-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-band`,
to apply to each individual band.

name: yAxis-plotBands-color
title: color
description: The color of the plot band.

name: yAxis-plotBands-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot band. Supported properties
are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: yAxis-plotBands-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotBands-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotBands-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotBands-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotBands-from
title: from
description:
The start position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: yAxis-plotBands-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot band in Axis.removePlotBand.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot bands

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description: Whether or not the label can be hidden if it overlaps with another label.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-inside
title: inside
description: Wether or not the text of the label can exceed the width of the label.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-rotation
title: rotation
description: Rotation of the text label in degrees .

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-band-label` class.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-text
title: text
description: The string text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot band. Can be one of
"top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: yAxis-plotBands-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: yAxis-plotBands-to
title: to
description:
The end position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: yAxis-plotBands-zIndex
title: zIndex
description:
The z index of the plot band within the chart, relative to other
elements. Using the same z index as another element may give
unpredictable results, as the last rendered element will be on top.
Values from 0 to 20 make sense.

name: yAxis-plotBands-innerRadius
title: innerRadius
description:
In a gauge chart, this option determines the inner radius of the
plot band that stretches along the perimeter. It can be given as
a percentage string, like `"100%"`, or as a pixel number, like `100`.
By default, the inner radius is controlled by the [thickness](#yAxis.plotBands.thickness) option.

name: yAxis-plotBands-outerRadius
title: outerRadius
description:
In a gauge chart, this option determines the outer radius of the
plot band that stretches along the perimeter. It can be given as
a percentage string, like `"100%"`, or as a pixel number, like `100`.

name: yAxis-plotBands-thickness
title: thickness
description:
In a gauge chart, this option sets the width of the plot band stretching
along the perimeter. It can be given as a percentage string, like `'10%'`, or
as a pixel number, like `10`. If `undefined`, the plot band fills out the
range between `pane.size` and `pane.innerSize`.

name: yAxis-plotLines-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-line`,
to apply to each individual line.

name: yAxis-plotLines-color
title: color
description: The color of the line.

name: yAxis-plotLines-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description:
The dashing or dot style for the plot line. For possible values see
[this overview](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: yAxis-plotLines-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot line. Supported
properties are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: yAxis-plotLines-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotLines-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotLines-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotLines-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: yAxis-plotLines-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot line in Axis.removePlotLine.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot lines

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. Useful properties like
the value of plot line or the range of plot band (`from` & `to`
properties) can be found in `this.options` object. Since v12.6.0, the
callback also receives `ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions
can access the same context as regular functions using `this`.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-rotation
title: rotation
description:
Rotation of the text label in degrees. Defaults to 0 for horizontal plot
lines and 90 for vertical lines.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-line-label` class.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-text
title: text
description: The text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot line. Can be
one of "top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: yAxis-plotLines-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: yAxis-plotLines-labels-clip
title: clip
description: Whether to hide labels that are outside the plot area.

name: yAxis-plotLines-value
title: value
description:
The position of the line in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: yAxis-plotLines-width
title: width
description: The width or thickness of the plot line.

name: yAxis-plotLines-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The z index of the plot line within the chart.

name: yAxis-reversed
title: reversed
description:
Whether to reverse the axis so that the highest number is closest
to the origin.

name: yAxis-reversedStacks
title: reversedStacks
description:
If `true`, the first series in a stack will be drawn on top in a
positive, non-reversed Y axis. If `false`, the first series is in
the base of the stack.

name: yAxis-showEmpty
title: showEmpty
description: Whether to show the axis line and title when the axis has no data.

name: yAxis-showFirstLabel
title: showFirstLabel
description: Whether to show the first tick label.

name: yAxis-showLastLabel
title: showLastLabel
description: Whether to show the last tick label.

name: yAxis-softMax
title: softMax
description:
A soft maximum for the axis. If the series data maximum is less
than this, the axis will stay at this maximum, but if the series
data maximum is higher, the axis will flex to show all data.

**Note**: The [series.softThreshold](#plotOptions.series.softThreshold) option takes precedence over this
option.

name: yAxis-softMin
title: softMin
description:
A soft minimum for the axis. If the series data minimum is greater
than this, the axis will stay at this minimum, but if the series
data minimum is lower, the axis will flex to show all data.

**Note**: The [series.softThreshold](#plotOptions.series.softThreshold) option takes precedence over this
option.

name: yAxis-startOfWeek
title: startOfWeek
description:
For datetime axes, this decides where to put the tick between weeks.
 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

name: yAxis-startOnTick
title: startOnTick
description:
Whether to force the axis to start on a tick. Use this option with
the `maxPadding` option to control the axis start.

This option is always disabled, when panning type is
either `y` or `xy`.

name: yAxis-staticScale
title: staticScale
description:
For vertical axes only. Setting the static scale ensures that each tick unit
is translated into a fixed pixel height. For example, setting the static
scale to 24 results in each Y axis category taking up 24 pixels, and the
height of the chart adjusts. Adding or removing items will make the chart
resize.

name: yAxis-tickAmount
title: tickAmount
description:
The amount of ticks to draw on the axis. This opens up for aligning
the ticks of multiple charts or panes within a chart. This option
overrides the `tickPixelInterval` option.

This option only has an effect on linear axes. Datetime, logarithmic
or category axes are not affected.

name: yAxis-tickColor
title: tickColor
description:
Color for the main tick marks.

In styled mode, the stroke is given in the `.highcharts-tick`
class.

name: yAxis-tickInterval
title: tickInterval
description:
The interval of the tick marks in axis units. When `undefined`, the
tick interval is computed to approximately follow the
[tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) on linear and datetime
axes. On categorized axes, a `undefined` tickInterval will default to
1, one category. Note that datetime axes are based on milliseconds,
so for example an interval of one day is expressed as
`24 * 3600 * 1000`.

On logarithmic axes, the tickInterval is based on powers, so a
tickInterval of 1 means one tick on each of 0.1, 1, 10, 100 etc. A
tickInterval of 2 means a tick of 0.1, 10, 1000 etc. A tickInterval
of 0.2 puts a tick on 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 20,
40 etc.


If the tickInterval is too dense for labels to be drawn, Highcharts
may remove ticks.

If the chart has multiple axes, the [alignTicks](#chart.alignTicks)
option may interfere with the `tickInterval` setting.

name: yAxis-tickLength
title: tickLength
description: The pixel length of the main tick marks.

name: yAxis-tickPosition
title: tickPosition
description:
The position of the major tick marks relative to the axis line.
Can be one of `inside` and `outside`.

name: yAxis-tickPositioner
title: tickPositioner
description:
A callback function returning array defining where the ticks are
laid out on the axis. This overrides the default behavior of
[tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) and [tickInterval](#xAxis.tickInterval). The automatic tick positions are accessible
through `this.tickPositions` and can be modified by the callback.
Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the third
argument, so that arrow functions can access the same context as
regular functions using `this`.

name: yAxis-tickPositions
title: tickPositions
description:
An array defining where the ticks are laid out on the axis. This
overrides the default behavior of [tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) and [tickInterval](#xAxis.tickInterval).

Note: When working with date-time axes, be aware of time zone
handling. See the [documentation on time options](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/axes#datetime)
for best practices.

name: yAxis-tickWidth
title: tickWidth
description: The pixel width of the major tick marks.

name: yAxis-tickmarkPlacement
title: tickmarkPlacement
description:
For categorized axes only. If `on` the tick mark is placed in the
center of the category, if `between` the tick mark is placed between
categories. The default is `between` if the `tickInterval` is 1, else
`on`. In order to render tick marks on a category axis it is necessary
to provide a [tickWidth](#xAxis.tickWidth).

name: yAxis-title-align
title: align
description:
Alignment of the title relative to the axis values. Possible
values are "low", "middle" or "high".

name: yAxis-title-margin
title: margin
description:
The pixel distance between the axis labels and the title.
Positive values are outside the axis line, negative are inside.

name: yAxis-title-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance from the plot area to the axis line. A positive
offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks away from
the plot area. With multiple axes the offset is dynamically
adjusted to avoid collision, this can be overridden by setting
offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string,
and defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the
pane and plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the
offset in radial axes.

name: yAxis-title-position3d
title: position3d
description:
Defines how the title is repositioned according to the 3D chart
orientation.

- `'offset'`: Maintain a fixed horizontal/vertical distance from
  the tick marks, despite the chart orientation. This is the
  backwards compatible behavior, and causes skewing of X and Z
  axes.

- `'chart'`: Preserve 3D position relative to the chart. This
  looks nice, but hard to read if the text isn't forward-facing.

- `'flap'`: Rotated text along the axis to compensate for the
  chart orientation. This tries to maintain text as legible as
  possible on all orientations.

- `'ortho'`: Rotated text along the axis direction so that the
  labels are orthogonal to the axis. This is very similar to
  `'flap'`, but prevents skewing the labels (X and Y scaling are
  still present).

- `undefined`: Will use the config from `labels.position3d`

name: yAxis-title-reserveSpace
title: reserveSpace
description: Whether to reserve space for the title when laying out the axis.

name: yAxis-title-rotation
title: rotation
description:
The rotation of the text in degrees. 0 is horizontal, 270 is
vertical reading from bottom to top. Defaults to 0 for horizontal
axes, 270 for left-side axes and 90 for right-side axes.

name: yAxis-title-skew3d
title: skew3d
description:
If enabled, the axis title will skewed to follow the perspective.

This will fix overlapping labels and titles, but texts become
less legible due to the distortion.

The final appearance depends heavily on `title.position3d`.

A `null` value will use the config from `labels.skew3d`.

name: yAxis-title-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the title. If the title text is longer than the
axis length, it will wrap to multiple lines by default. This can
be customized by setting the `lineClamp` property, by setting a
specific `width` or by setting `whiteSpace: 'nowrap'`.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-axis-title` class.

name: yAxis-title-text
title: text
description:
The actual text of the axis title. Horizontal texts can contain
HTML, but rotated texts are painted using vector techniques and
must be clean text. The Y axis title is disabled by setting the
`text` option to `undefined`. The default value is overridden by
the `lang.yAxisTitle` language option.

name: yAxis-title-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
Alignment of the text, can be `"left"`, `"right"` or `"center"`.
Default alignment depends on the
[title.align](xAxis.title.align):

Horizontal axes:
- for `align` = `"low"`, `textAlign` is set to `left`
- for `align` = `"middle"`, `textAlign` is set to `center`
- for `align` = `"high"`, `textAlign` is set to `right`

Vertical axes:
- for `align` = `"low"` and `opposite` = `true`, `textAlign` is
  set to `right`
- for `align` = `"low"` and `opposite` = `false`, `textAlign` is
  set to `left`
- for `align` = `"middle"`, `textAlign` is set to `center`
- for `align` = `"high"` and `opposite` = `true` `textAlign` is
  set to `left`
- for `align` = `"high"` and `opposite` = `false` `textAlign` is
  set to `right`

name: yAxis-title-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the axis title.

name: yAxis-title-x
title: x
description: Horizontal pixel offset of the title position.

name: yAxis-title-y
title: y
description: Vertical pixel offset of the title position.

name: yAxis-top
title: top
description:
The top position of the Y axis. If it's a number, it is interpreted
as pixel position relative to the chart.

Since Highcharts 2: If it's a percentage string, it is interpreted as
percentages of the plot height, offset from plot area top.

name: yAxis-type
title: type
description:
The type of axis. Can be one of `linear`, `logarithmic`, `datetime`,
`category` or `treegrid`. Defaults to `treegrid` for Gantt charts,
`linear` for other chart types.

In a datetime axis, the numbers are given in milliseconds, and tick
marks are placed on appropriate values, like full hours or days. In a
category or treegrid axis, the [point names](#series.line.data.name)
of the chart's series are used for categories, if a
[categories](#xAxis.categories) array is not defined.

name: yAxis-uniqueNames
title: uniqueNames
description:
Applies only when the axis `type` is `category`. When `uniqueNames`
is true, points are placed on the X axis according to their names.
If the same point name is repeated in the same or another series,
the point is placed on the same X position as other points of the
same name. When `uniqueNames` is false, the points are laid out in
increasing X positions regardless of their names, and the X axis
category will take the name of the last point in each position.

name: yAxis-units
title: units
description:
Datetime axis only. An array determining what time intervals the
ticks are allowed to fall on. Each array item is an array where the
first value is the time unit and the second value another array of
allowed multiples.

Defaults to:
```js
units: [[
    'millisecond', // unit name
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500] // allowed multiples
], [
    'second',
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
], [
    'minute',
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
], [
    'hour',
    [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12]
], [
    'day',
    [1, 2]
], [
    'week',
    [1, 2]
], [
    'month',
    [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
], [
    'year',
    null
]]
```

name: yAxis-visible
title: visible
description:
Whether axis, including axis title, line, ticks and labels, should
be visible.

name: yAxis-width
title: width
description:
The width as the horizontal axis. If it's a number, it is interpreted
as pixels.

Since Highcharts v5.0.13: If it's a percentage string, it is
interpreted as percentages of the total plot width.

name: yAxis-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index for the axis group.

name: yAxis-zoomEnabled
title: zoomEnabled
description:
Whether to zoom axis. If `chart.zoomType` is set, the option allows
to disable zooming on an individual axis.

name: yAxis-maxColor
title: maxColor
description:
Solid gauge only. Unless [stops](#yAxis.stops) are set, the color
to represent the maximum value of the Y axis.

name: yAxis-minColor
title: minColor
description:
Solid gauge only. Unless [stops](#yAxis.stops) are set, the color
to represent the minimum value of the Y axis.

name: yAxis-stackLabels
title: stackLabels
description:
The stack labels show the total value for each bar in a stacked
column or bar chart. The label will be placed on top of positive
columns and below negative columns. In case of an inverted column
chart or a bar chart the label is placed to the right of positive
bars and to the left of negative bars.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-align
title: align
description:
Defines the horizontal alignment of the stack total label. Can be
one of `"left"`, `"center"` or `"right"`. The default value is
calculated at runtime and depends on orientation and whether the
stack is positive or negative.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description: Allow the stack labels to overlap.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-animation
title: animation
description:
Enable or disable the initial animation when a series is
displayed for the `stackLabels`. The animation can also be set as
a configuration object. Please note that this option only
applies to the initial animation.
For other animations, see [chart.animation](#chart.animation)
and the animation parameter under the API methods.
The following properties are supported:

- `defer`: The animation delay time in milliseconds.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-animation-defer
title: defer
description:
The animation delay time in milliseconds.
Set to `0` renders stackLabel immediately.
As `undefined` inherits defer time from the [series.animation.defer](#plotOptions.series.animation.defer).

name: yAxis-stackLabels-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description: The background color or gradient for the stack label.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The border color for the stack label. Defaults to `undefined`.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: The border radius in pixels for the stack label.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The border width in pixels for the stack label.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-crop
title: crop
description:
Whether to hide stack labels that are outside the plot area.
By default, the stack label is moved
inside the plot area according to the
[overflow](/highcharts/#yAxis/stackLabels/overflow)
option.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable the stack total labels.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the data label. Available variables are the
same as for `formatter`.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. The value is
given by `this.total`. Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives
`ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions can access
the same context as regular functions using `this`.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-overflow
title: overflow
description:
How to handle stack total labels that flow outside the plot area.
The default is set to `"justify"`,
which aligns them inside the plot area.
For columns and bars, this means it will be moved inside the bar.
To display stack labels outside the plot area,
set `crop` to `false` and `overflow` to `"allow"`.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-rotation
title: rotation
description: Rotation of the labels in degrees.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the label.

In styled mode, the styles are set in the
`.highcharts-stack-label` class.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where
the texts anchor point is placed with regards to the stack,
`textAlign` determines how the text is aligned against its anchor
point. Possible values are `"left"`, `"center"` and `"right"`.
The default value is calculated at runtime and depends on
orientation and whether the stack is positive or negative.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Defines the vertical alignment of the stack total label. Can be
one of `"top"`, `"middle"` or `"bottom"`. The default value is
calculated at runtime and depends on orientation and whether the
stack is positive or negative.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-x
title: x
description:
The x position offset of the label relative to the left of the
stacked bar. The default value is calculated at runtime and
depends on orientation and whether the stack is positive or
negative.

name: yAxis-stackLabels-y
title: y
description:
The y position offset of the label relative to the tick position
on the axis. The default value is calculated at runtime and
depends on orientation and whether the stack is positive or
negative.

name: yAxis-stackShadow
title: stackShadow
description:
Relevant only for pictorial series. The `stackShadow` forms the background of
stacked points. Requires `series.stacking` to be defined.

name: yAxis-stackShadow-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The color of the `stackShadow` border.

name: yAxis-stackShadow-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The width of the `stackShadow` border.

name: yAxis-stackShadow-color
title: color
description: The color of the `stackShadow`.

name: yAxis-stackShadow-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable `stackShadow`.

name: yAxis-stops
title: stops
description:
Solid gauge series only. Color stops for the solid gauge. Use this
in cases where a linear gradient between a `minColor` and `maxColor`
is not sufficient. The stops is an array of tuples, where the first
item is a float between 0 and 1 assigning the relative position in
the gradient, and the second item is the color.

For solid gauges, the Y axis also inherits the concept of
[data classes](https://api.highcharts.com/highmaps#colorAxis.dataClasses)
from the Highmaps color axis.

name: yAxis-tooltipValueFormat
title: tooltipValueFormat
description:
Parallel coordinates only. Format that will be used for point.y
and available in [tooltip.pointFormat](#tooltip.pointFormat) as
`{point.formattedValue}`. If not set, `{point.formattedValue}`
will use other options, in this order:

1. [yAxis.labels.format](#yAxis.labels.format) will be used if
   set

2. If yAxis is a category, then category name will be displayed

3. If yAxis is a datetime, then value will use the same format as
   yAxis labels

4. If yAxis is linear/logarithmic type, then simple value will be
   used

name: zAxis
title: zAxis
description:
The Z axis or depth axis for 3D plots.

See the [Axis class](/class-reference/Highcharts.Axis) for programmatic
access to the axis.

name: zAxis-accessibility
title: accessibility
description: Accessibility options for an axis. Requires the accessibility module.

name: zAxis-accessibility-description
title: description
description: Description for an axis to expose to screen reader users.

name: zAxis-accessibility-enabled
title: enabled
description:
Enable axis accessibility features, including axis information in the
screen reader information region. If this is disabled on the xAxis, the
x values are not exposed to screen readers for the individual data points
by default.

name: zAxis-accessibility-rangeDescription
title: rangeDescription
description:
Range description for an axis. Overrides the default range description.
Set to empty to disable range description for this axis.

name: zAxis-alignTicks
title: alignTicks
description:
When using multiple axis, the ticks of two or more opposite axes
will automatically be aligned by adding ticks to the axis or axes
with the least ticks, as if `tickAmount` were specified.

This can be prevented by setting `alignTicks` to false. If the grid
lines look messy, it's a good idea to hide them for the secondary
axis by setting `gridLineWidth` to 0.

If `startOnTick` or `endOnTick` in an Axis options are set to false,
then the `alignTicks ` will be disabled for the Axis.

Disabled for logarithmic axes.

name: zAxis-allowDecimals
title: allowDecimals
description:
Whether to allow decimals in this axis' ticks. When counting
integers, like persons or hits on a web page, decimals should
be avoided in the labels. By default, decimals are allowed on small
scale axes.

name: zAxis-alternateGridColor
title: alternateGridColor
description:
When using an alternate grid color, a band is painted across the
plot area between every other grid line.

name: zAxis-angle
title: angle
description:
In a polar chart, this is the angle of the Y axis in degrees, where
0 is up and 90 is right. The angle determines the position of the
axis line and the labels, though the coordinate system is unaffected.
Since v8.0.0 this option is also applicable for X axis (inverted
polar).

name: zAxis-categories
title: categories
description:
If categories are present for the xAxis, names are used instead of
numbers for that axis.

Since Highcharts 3.0, categories can also
be extracted by giving each point a [name](#series.data) and setting
axis [type](#xAxis.type) to `category`. However, if you have multiple
series, best practice remains defining the `categories` array.

Example: `categories: ['Apples', 'Bananas', 'Oranges']`

name: zAxis-ceiling
title: ceiling
description: The highest allowed value for automatically computed axis extremes.

name: zAxis-className
title: className
description:
A class name that opens for styling the axis by CSS, especially in
Highcharts styled mode. The class name is applied to group elements
for the grid, axis elements and labels.

name: zAxis-crossing
title: crossing
description:
The value on a perpendicular axis where this axis should cross. This
is typically used on mathematical plots where the axes cross at 0.
When `crossing` is set, space will not be reserved at the sides of
the chart for axis labels and title, so those may be clipped. In this
case it is better to place the axes without the `crossing` option.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats
title: dateTimeLabelFormats
description:
For a datetime axis, the scale will automatically adjust to the
appropriate unit. This member gives the default representations used
for each unit. For easier data interpretation, `hour`, `day`, `month`
and `year` units can be used and formatted as boundary tick values.
Check boundaries map below to see where to format boundary ticks on
given main time units.

```js
    baseUnit: boundaryUnit
    ----------------------
    millisecond: 'hour',
    second: 'hour',
    minute: 'hour',
    hour: 'day',
    day: 'month',
    week: 'month',
    month: 'year',
    year: 'year'
```

For an overview of the date time label formats configuration, see
[dateFormat](/class-reference/Highcharts.Time#dateFormat).

Defaults to:
```js
{
    millisecond: { main: '%[HMSL]' },
    second: { main: '%[HMS]' },
    minute: { main: '%[HM]' },
    hour: { main: '%[HM]', boundary: undefined },
    day: { main: '%[eb]', boundary: '%[eb]' },
    week: { main: '%[eb]' },
    month: { main: '%[bY]', boundary: undefined },
    year: { main: '%Y', boundary: undefined }
}
```

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-day-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-day-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-hour-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-hour-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-millisecond-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-minute-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-month-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-month-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-second-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-week-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-year-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: zAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-year-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: zAxis-endOnTick
title: endOnTick
description:
Whether to force the axis to end on a tick. Use this option with
the `maxPadding` option to control the axis end.

name: zAxis-events
title: events
description: Event handlers for the axis.

name: zAxis-events-afterBreaks
title: afterBreaks
description: An event fired after the breaks have rendered.

name: zAxis-events-afterSetExtremes
title: afterSetExtremes
description:
As opposed to the `setExtremes` event, this event fires after the
final min and max values are computed and corrected for `minRange`.

Fires when the minimum and maximum is set for the axis, either by
calling the `.setExtremes()` method or by selecting an area in the
chart. One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function, containing
common event information.

The new user set minimum and maximum values can be found by
`event.min` and `event.max`. These reflect the axis minimum and
maximum in axis values. The actual data extremes are found in
`event.dataMin` and `event.dataMax`.

name: zAxis-events-pointBreak
title: pointBreak
description: An event fired when a break from this axis occurs on a point.

name: zAxis-events-pointInBreak
title: pointInBreak
description: An event fired when a point falls inside a break from this axis.

name: zAxis-events-setExtremes
title: setExtremes
description:
Fires when the minimum and maximum is set for the axis, either by
calling the `.setExtremes()` method or by selecting an area in the
chart. One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function,
containing common event information.

The new user set minimum and maximum values can be found by
`event.min` and `event.max`. These reflect the axis minimum and
maximum in data values. When an axis is zoomed all the way out from
the "Reset zoom" button, `event.min` and `event.max` are null, and
the new extremes are set based on `this.dataMin` and `this.dataMax`.

name: zAxis-floor
title: floor
description: The lowest allowed value for automatically computed axis extremes.

name: zAxis-gridLineColor
title: gridLineColor
description:
Color of the grid lines extending the ticks across the plot area.

In styled mode, the stroke is given in the `.highcharts-grid-line`
class.

name: zAxis-gridLineDashStyle
title: gridLineDashStyle
description:
The dash or dot style of the grid lines. For possible values, see
[this demonstration](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: zAxis-gridLineInterpolation
title: gridLineInterpolation
description:
Polar charts only. Whether the grid lines should draw as a polygon
with straight lines between categories, or as circles. Can be either
`circle` or `polygon`. Since v8.0.0 this option is also applicable
for X axis (inverted polar).

name: zAxis-gridLineWidth
title: gridLineWidth
description:
The width of the grid lines extending the ticks across the plot area.
Defaults to 1 on the Y axis and 0 on the X axis, except for 3d
charts and gauges.

In gauges, the grid lines are limited to the pane's `size` and
`innerSize`.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-grid-line` class.

name: zAxis-gridZIndex
title: gridZIndex
description: The Z index of the grid lines.

name: zAxis-id
title: id
description:
An id for the axis. This can be used after render time to get
a pointer to the axis object through `chart.get()`.

name: zAxis-labels
title: labels
description:
The axis labels show the number or category for each tick.

Since v8.0.0: Labels are animated in categorized x-axis with
updating data if `tickInterval` and `step` is set to 1.

name: zAxis-labels-align
title: align
description:
What part of the string the given position is anchored to.
If `left`, the left side of the string is at the axis position.
Can be one of `"left"`, `"center"` or `"right"`. Defaults to
an intelligent guess based on which side of the chart the axis
is on and the rotation of the label.

name: zAxis-labels-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description:
Whether to allow the axis labels to overlap. When false,
overlapping labels are hidden.

name: zAxis-labels-autoRotation
title: autoRotation
description:
For horizontal axes, the allowed degrees of label rotation
to prevent overlapping labels. If there is enough space,
labels are not rotated. As the chart gets narrower, it
will start rotating the labels -45 degrees, then remove
every second label and try again with rotations 0 and -45 etc.
Set it to `undefined` to disable rotation, which will
cause the labels to word-wrap if possible. Defaults to `[-45]``
on bottom and top axes, `undefined` on left and right axes.

name: zAxis-labels-autoRotationLimit
title: autoRotationLimit
description:
When each category width is more than this many pixels, we don't
apply auto rotation. Instead, we lay out the axis label with word
wrap. A lower limit makes sense when the label contains multiple
short words that don't extend the available horizontal space for
each label.

name: zAxis-labels-distance
title: distance
description:
The label's pixel distance from the perimeter of the plot area.
On cartesian charts, this is overridden if the `labels.y` setting
is set. Defaults to 15 unless the labels are aligned inside the
plot area, in which case it defaults to 0.

name: zAxis-labels-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable the axis labels.

name: zAxis-labels-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the axis label. The context is available as
format string variables. For example, you can use `{text}` to
insert the default formatted text. The recommended way of adding
units for the label is using `text`, for example `{text} km`.

To add custom numeric or datetime formatting, use `{value}` with
formatting, for example `{value:.1f}` or `{value:%Y-%m-%d}`.

See
[format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
for more examples of formatting.

The default value is not specified due to the dynamic
nature of the default implementation.

name: zAxis-labels-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. The value
is given by `this.value`. Additional properties for `this` are
`axis`, `chart`, `isFirst`, `isLast` and `text` which holds the
value of the default formatter. Since v12.6.0, the callback also
receives `ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions can
access the same context as regular functions using `this`.

Defaults to a built in function returning a formatted string
depending on whether the axis is `category`, `datetime`,
`numeric` or other.

name: zAxis-labels-overflow
title: overflow
description:
How to handle overflowing labels on horizontal axis. If set to
`"allow"`, it will not be aligned at all. By default it
`"justify"` labels inside the chart area. If there is room to
move it, it will be aligned to the edge, else it will be removed.

name: zAxis-labels-padding
title: padding
description:
The pixel padding for axis labels, to ensure white space between
them. Defaults to 4 for horizontal axes, 1 for vertical.

name: zAxis-labels-position3d
title: position3d
description:
Defines how the labels are be repositioned according to the 3D
chart orientation.

- `'offset'`: Maintain a fixed horizontal/vertical distance from
  the tick marks, despite the chart orientation. This is the
  backwards compatible behavior, and causes skewing of X and Z
  axes.

- `'chart'`: Preserve 3D position relative to the chart. This
  looks nice, but hard to read if the text isn't forward-facing.

- `'flap'`: Rotated text along the axis to compensate for the
  chart orientation. This tries to maintain text as legible as
  possible on all orientations.

- `'ortho'`: Rotated text along the axis direction so that the
  labels are orthogonal to the axis. This is very similar to
  `'flap'`, but prevents skewing the labels (X and Y scaling are
  still present).

name: zAxis-labels-reserveSpace
title: reserveSpace
description:
Whether to reserve space for the labels. By default, space is
reserved for the labels in these cases:

* On all horizontal axes.
* On vertical axes if `label.align` is `right` on a left-side
axis or `left` on a right-side axis.
* On vertical axes if `label.align` is `center`.

This can be turned off when for example the labels are rendered
inside the plot area instead of outside.

name: zAxis-labels-rotation
title: rotation
description:
Rotation of the labels in degrees. When `undefined`, the
`autoRotation` option takes precedence.

name: zAxis-labels-skew3d
title: skew3d
description:
If enabled, the axis labels will skewed to follow the
perspective.

This will fix overlapping labels and titles, but texts become
less legible due to the distortion.

The final appearance depends heavily on `labels.position3d`.

name: zAxis-labels-staggerLines
title: staggerLines
description:
Horizontal axes only. The number of lines to spread the labels
over to make room or tighter labels. 0 disables staggering.

name: zAxis-labels-step
title: step
description:
To show only every _n_'th label on the axis, set the step to _n_.
Setting the step to 2 shows every other label.

By default, when 0, the step is calculated automatically to avoid
overlap. To prevent this, set it to 1\. This usually only
happens on a category axis, and is often a sign that you have
chosen the wrong axis type.

Read more at
[Axis docs](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/axes)
=> What axis should I use?

name: zAxis-labels-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the label. Use `lineClamp` to control wrapping of
category labels. Use `textOverflow: 'none'` to prevent ellipsis
(dots).

In styled mode, the labels are styled with the
`.highcharts-axis-labels` class.

name: zAxis-labels-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: zAxis-labels-x
title: x
description:
The x position offset of all labels relative to the tick
positions on the axis. Overrides the `labels.distance` option.

name: zAxis-labels-y
title: y
description:
The y position offset of all labels relative to the tick
positions on the axis. Overrides the `labels.distance` option.

name: zAxis-labels-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index for the axis labels.

name: zAxis-linkedTo
title: linkedTo
description:
Index or [id](#xAxis.id) of another axis that this axis is linked to.
When an axis is linked to a master axis, it will take the same
extremes as the master, but as assigned by min or max or by
`setExtremes`. It can be used to show additional info, or to ease
reading the chart by duplicating the scales.

name: zAxis-margin
title: margin
description:
If there are multiple axes on the same side of the chart, the pixel
margin between the axes. Defaults to 0 on vertical axes, 15 on
horizontal axes.

name: zAxis-max
title: max
description:
The maximum value of the axis. If `undefined`, the max value is
automatically calculated.

If a datetime string is passed, it is parsed into epoch time
according to the time zone given in [time.timezone](#time.timezone).

If the [endOnTick](#yAxis.endOnTick) option is true, the `max` value
might be rounded up.

If a [tickAmount](#yAxis.tickAmount) is set, the axis may be extended
beyond the set max in order to reach the given number of ticks. The
same may happen in a chart with multiple axes, determined by [chart.
alignTicks](#chart), where a `tickAmount` is applied internally.

name: zAxis-maxPadding
title: maxPadding
description:
Padding of the max value relative to the length of the axis. A
padding of 0.05 will make a 100px axis 5px longer. This is useful
when you don't want the highest data value to appear on the edge
of the plot area. When the axis' `max` option is set or a max extreme
is set using `axis.setExtremes()`, the maxPadding will be ignored.

name: zAxis-min
title: min
description:
The minimum value of the axis. If `undefined`, the min value is
automatically calculated.

If a datetime string is passed, it is parsed into epoch time
according to the time zone given in [time.timezone](#time.timezone).

If the [startOnTick](#yAxis.startOnTick) option is true (default),
the `min` value might be rounded down.

The automatically calculated minimum value is also affected by
[floor](#yAxis.floor), [softMin](#yAxis.softMin),
[minPadding](#yAxis.minPadding), [minRange](#yAxis.minRange)
as well as [series.threshold](#plotOptions.series.threshold)
and [series.softThreshold](#plotOptions.series.softThreshold).

name: zAxis-minPadding
title: minPadding
description:
Padding of the min value relative to the length of the axis. A
padding of 0.05 will make a 100px axis 5px longer. This is useful
when you don't want the lowest data value to appear on the edge
of the plot area. When the axis' `min` option is set or a min extreme
is set using `axis.setExtremes()`, the minPadding will be ignored.

name: zAxis-minRange
title: minRange
description:
The minimum range to display on this axis. The entire axis will not
be allowed to span over a smaller interval than this. For example,
for a datetime axis the main unit is milliseconds. If minRange is
set to 3600000, you can't zoom in more than to one hour.

The default minRange for the x axis is five times the smallest
interval between any of the data points.

On a logarithmic axis, the unit for the minimum range is the power.
So a minRange of 1 means that the axis can be zoomed to 10-100,
100-1000, 1000-10000 etc.

**Note**: The `minPadding`, `maxPadding`, `startOnTick` and
`endOnTick` settings also affect how the extremes of the axis
are computed.

name: zAxis-minTickInterval
title: minTickInterval
description:
The minimum tick interval allowed in axis values. For example on
zooming in on an axis with daily data, this can be used to prevent
the axis from showing hours. Defaults to the closest distance between
two points on the axis.

name: zAxis-minorGridLineColor
title: minorGridLineColor
description:
Color of the minor, secondary grid lines.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-minor-grid-line` class.

name: zAxis-minorGridLineDashStyle
title: minorGridLineDashStyle
description:
The dash or dot style of the minor grid lines. For possible values,
see [this demonstration](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: zAxis-minorGridLineWidth
title: minorGridLineWidth
description:
Width of the minor, secondary grid lines.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-grid-line` class.

name: zAxis-minorTickColor
title: minorTickColor
description: Color for the minor tick marks.

name: zAxis-minorTickInterval
title: minorTickInterval
description:
Specific tick interval in axis units for the minor ticks. On a linear
axis, if `"auto"`, the minor tick interval is calculated as a fifth
of the tickInterval. If `undefined`, minor ticks are not shown.

On logarithmic axes, the unit is the power of the value. For example,
setting the minorTickInterval to 1 puts one tick on each of 0.1, 1,
10, 100 etc. Setting the minorTickInterval to 0.1 produces 9 ticks
between 1 and 10, 10 and 100 etc.

If user settings dictate minor ticks to become too dense, they don't
make sense, and will be ignored to prevent performance problems.

name: zAxis-minorTickLength
title: minorTickLength
description: The pixel length of the minor tick marks.

name: zAxis-minorTickPosition
title: minorTickPosition
description:
The position of the minor tick marks relative to the axis line.
 Can be one of `inside` and `outside`.

name: zAxis-minorTickWidth
title: minorTickWidth
description: The pixel width of the minor tick mark.

name: zAxis-minorTicks
title: minorTicks
description:
Enable or disable minor ticks. The interval between the minor ticks
can be controlled either by the
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor) setting, or as an
absolute [minorTickInterval](#xAxis.minorTickInterval) value.

On a logarithmic axis, minor ticks are laid out based on a best
guess, attempting to enter an approximate number of minor ticks
between each major tick based on
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor).

Prior to v6.0.0, ticks were enabled in auto layout by setting
`minorTickInterval` to `"auto"`.

name: zAxis-minorTicksPerMajor
title: minorTicksPerMajor
description:
The number of minor ticks per major tick. Works for `linear`,
`logarithmic` and `datetime` axes.

For radial axes in gauges, the default value is 10.

name: zAxis-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance in pixels from the plot area to the axis line.
A positive offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks
away from the plot area. This is typically used when two or more
axes are displayed on the same side of the plot. With multiple
axes the offset is dynamically adjusted to avoid collision, this
can be overridden by setting offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string, and
defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the pane and
plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the offset in
radial axes.

name: zAxis-opposite
title: opposite
description:
Whether to display the axis on the opposite side of the normal. The
normal is on the left side for vertical axes and bottom for
horizontal, so the opposite sides will be right and top respectively.
This is typically used with dual or multiple axes.

name: zAxis-pane
title: pane
description:
Refers to the index in the [panes](#panes) array. Used for circular
gauges and polar charts. When the option is not set then first pane
will be used.

name: zAxis-panningEnabled
title: panningEnabled
description:
Whether to pan axis. If `chart.panning` is enabled, the option
allows to disable panning on an individual axis.

name: zAxis-plotBands
title: plotBands
description:
An array of colored bands stretching across the plot area marking an
interval on the axis.

In styled mode, the plot bands are styled by the `.highcharts-plot-band`
class in addition to the `className` option.

When doing `Chart.update()` or `Axis.update()`, the plot bands are updated
by index or id. The following merging rules apply:
- If `plotBands` are not defined in the new options, all existing plot bands
  are kept.
- If `plotBands` are defined without ids, the existing plot bands are updated
  by index. If the new array has fewer plot bands, the remaining existing
  plot bands are removed. If the new array has more plot bands, the extra
  ones are added. An empty array removes all existing plot bands.
- If `plotBands` are defined with ids, the existing plot bands are matched
  by id, and remaining unmatched existing plot bands are removed.

name: zAxis-plotBands-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: Border color for the plot band. Also requires `borderWidth` to be set.

name: zAxis-plotBands-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
Border radius for the plot band. Applies only to gauges. Can be a pixel
value or a percentage, for example `50%`.

name: zAxis-plotBands-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: Border width for the plot band. Also requires `borderColor` to be set.

name: zAxis-plotBands-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-band`,
to apply to each individual band.

name: zAxis-plotBands-color
title: color
description: The color of the plot band.

name: zAxis-plotBands-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot band. Supported properties
are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: zAxis-plotBands-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotBands-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotBands-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotBands-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotBands-from
title: from
description:
The start position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: zAxis-plotBands-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot band in Axis.removePlotBand.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot bands

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description: Whether or not the label can be hidden if it overlaps with another label.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-inside
title: inside
description: Wether or not the text of the label can exceed the width of the label.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-rotation
title: rotation
description: Rotation of the text label in degrees .

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-band-label` class.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-text
title: text
description: The string text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot band. Can be one of
"top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: zAxis-plotBands-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: zAxis-plotBands-to
title: to
description:
The end position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: zAxis-plotBands-zIndex
title: zIndex
description:
The z index of the plot band within the chart, relative to other
elements. Using the same z index as another element may give
unpredictable results, as the last rendered element will be on top.
Values from 0 to 20 make sense.

name: zAxis-plotLines
title: plotLines
description:
An array of lines stretching across the plot area, marking a specific
value on one of the axes.

In styled mode, the plot lines are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-line` class in addition to the `className` option.

When doing `Chart.update()` or `Axis.update()`, the plot lines are updated
by index or id. The following merging rules apply:
- If `plotLines` are not defined in the new options, all existing plot lines
  are kept.
- If `plotLines` are defined without ids, the existing plot lines are updated
  by index. If the new array has fewer plot lines, the remaining existing
  plot lines are removed. If the new array has more plot lines, the extra
  ones are added. An empty array removes all existing plot lines.
- If `plotLines` are defined with ids, the existing plot lines are matched
  by id, and remaining unmatched existing plot lines are removed.

name: zAxis-plotLines-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-line`,
to apply to each individual line.

name: zAxis-plotLines-color
title: color
description: The color of the line.

name: zAxis-plotLines-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description:
The dashing or dot style for the plot line. For possible values see
[this overview](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: zAxis-plotLines-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot line. Supported
properties are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: zAxis-plotLines-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotLines-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotLines-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotLines-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: zAxis-plotLines-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot line in Axis.removePlotLine.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot lines

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. Useful properties like
the value of plot line or the range of plot band (`from` & `to`
properties) can be found in `this.options` object. Since v12.6.0, the
callback also receives `ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions
can access the same context as regular functions using `this`.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-rotation
title: rotation
description:
Rotation of the text label in degrees. Defaults to 0 for horizontal plot
lines and 90 for vertical lines.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-line-label` class.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-text
title: text
description: The text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot line. Can be
one of "top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: zAxis-plotLines-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: zAxis-plotLines-labels-clip
title: clip
description: Whether to hide labels that are outside the plot area.

name: zAxis-plotLines-value
title: value
description:
The position of the line in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: zAxis-plotLines-width
title: width
description: The width or thickness of the plot line.

name: zAxis-plotLines-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The z index of the plot line within the chart.

name: zAxis-reversed
title: reversed
description:
Whether to reverse the axis so that the highest number is closest
to the origin. If the chart is inverted, the x axis is reversed by
default.

name: zAxis-reversedStacks
title: reversedStacks
description:
This option determines how stacks should be ordered within a group.
For example reversed xAxis also reverses stacks, so first series
comes last in a group. To keep order like for non-reversed xAxis
enable this option.

name: zAxis-showFirstLabel
title: showFirstLabel
description: Whether to show the first tick label.

name: zAxis-showLastLabel
title: showLastLabel
description:
Whether to show the last tick label. Defaults to `true` on cartesian
charts, and `false` on polar charts.

name: zAxis-softMax
title: softMax
description:
A soft maximum for the axis. If the series data maximum is less than
this, the axis will stay at this maximum, but if the series data
maximum is higher, the axis will flex to show all data.

name: zAxis-softMin
title: softMin
description:
A soft minimum for the axis. If the series data minimum is greater
than this, the axis will stay at this minimum, but if the series
data minimum is lower, the axis will flex to show all data.

name: zAxis-startOfWeek
title: startOfWeek
description:
For datetime axes, this decides where to put the tick between weeks.
 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

name: zAxis-startOnTick
title: startOnTick
description:
Whether to force the axis to start on a tick. Use this option with
the `minPadding` option to control the axis start.

name: zAxis-staticScale
title: staticScale
description:
For vertical axes only. Setting the static scale ensures that each tick unit
is translated into a fixed pixel height. For example, setting the static
scale to 24 results in each Y axis category taking up 24 pixels, and the
height of the chart adjusts. Adding or removing items will make the chart
resize.

name: zAxis-tickAmount
title: tickAmount
description:
The amount of ticks to draw on the axis. This opens up for aligning
the ticks of multiple charts or panes within a chart. This option
overrides the `tickPixelInterval` option.

This option only has an effect on linear axes. Datetime, logarithmic
or category axes are not affected.

name: zAxis-tickColor
title: tickColor
description:
Color for the main tick marks.

In styled mode, the stroke is given in the `.highcharts-tick`
class.

name: zAxis-tickInterval
title: tickInterval
description:
The interval of the tick marks in axis units. When `undefined`, the
tick interval is computed to approximately follow the
[tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) on linear and datetime
axes. On categorized axes, a `undefined` tickInterval will default to
1, one category. Note that datetime axes are based on milliseconds,
so for example an interval of one day is expressed as
`24 * 3600 * 1000`.

On logarithmic axes, the tickInterval is based on powers, so a
tickInterval of 1 means one tick on each of 0.1, 1, 10, 100 etc. A
tickInterval of 2 means a tick of 0.1, 10, 1000 etc. A tickInterval
of 0.2 puts a tick on 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 20,
40 etc.


If the tickInterval is too dense for labels to be drawn, Highcharts
may remove ticks.

If the chart has multiple axes, the [alignTicks](#chart.alignTicks)
option may interfere with the `tickInterval` setting.

name: zAxis-tickLength
title: tickLength
description: The pixel length of the main tick marks.

name: zAxis-tickPixelInterval
title: tickPixelInterval
description:
If tickInterval is `null` this option sets the approximate pixel
interval of the tick marks. Not applicable to categorized axis.

The tick interval is also influenced by the [minTickInterval](#xAxis.minTickInterval) option, that, by default prevents ticks from
being denser than the data points.

name: zAxis-tickPosition
title: tickPosition
description:
The position of the major tick marks relative to the axis line.
Can be one of `inside` and `outside`.

name: zAxis-tickPositioner
title: tickPositioner
description:
A callback function returning array defining where the ticks are
laid out on the axis. This overrides the default behavior of
[tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) and [tickInterval](#xAxis.tickInterval). The automatic tick positions are accessible
through `this.tickPositions` and can be modified by the callback.
Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the third
argument, so that arrow functions can access the same context as
regular functions using `this`.

name: zAxis-tickPositions
title: tickPositions
description:
An array defining where the ticks are laid out on the axis. This
overrides the default behavior of [tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) and [tickInterval](#xAxis.tickInterval).

Note: When working with date-time axes, be aware of time zone
handling. See the [documentation on time options](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/axes#datetime)
for best practices.

name: zAxis-tickWidth
title: tickWidth
description:
The pixel width of the major tick marks. Defaults to 0 on category
axes, otherwise 1.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the `.highcharts-tick`
class, but in order for the element to be generated on category axes,
the option must be explicitly set to 1.

name: zAxis-tickmarkPlacement
title: tickmarkPlacement
description:
For categorized axes only. If `on` the tick mark is placed in the
center of the category, if `between` the tick mark is placed between
categories. The default is `between` if the `tickInterval` is 1, else
`on`. In order to render tick marks on a category axis it is necessary
to provide a [tickWidth](#xAxis.tickWidth).

name: zAxis-title
title: title
description: The axis title, showing next to the axis line.

name: zAxis-title-align
title: align
description:
Alignment of the title relative to the axis values. Possible
values are "low", "middle" or "high".

name: zAxis-title-margin
title: margin
description:
The pixel distance between the axis labels or line and the title.
Defaults to 0 for horizontal axes, 10 for vertical

name: zAxis-title-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance from the plot area to the axis line. A positive
offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks away from
the plot area. With multiple axes the offset is dynamically
adjusted to avoid collision, this can be overridden by setting
offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string,
and defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the
pane and plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the
offset in radial axes.

name: zAxis-title-position3d
title: position3d
description:
Defines how the title is repositioned according to the 3D chart
orientation.

- `'offset'`: Maintain a fixed horizontal/vertical distance from
  the tick marks, despite the chart orientation. This is the
  backwards compatible behavior, and causes skewing of X and Z
  axes.

- `'chart'`: Preserve 3D position relative to the chart. This
  looks nice, but hard to read if the text isn't forward-facing.

- `'flap'`: Rotated text along the axis to compensate for the
  chart orientation. This tries to maintain text as legible as
  possible on all orientations.

- `'ortho'`: Rotated text along the axis direction so that the
  labels are orthogonal to the axis. This is very similar to
  `'flap'`, but prevents skewing the labels (X and Y scaling are
  still present).

- `undefined`: Will use the config from `labels.position3d`

name: zAxis-title-reserveSpace
title: reserveSpace
description: Whether to reserve space for the title when laying out the axis.

name: zAxis-title-rotation
title: rotation
description:
The rotation of the text in degrees. 0 is horizontal, 270 is
vertical reading from bottom to top. Defaults to 0 for horizontal
axes, 270 for left-side axes and 90 for right-side axes.

name: zAxis-title-skew3d
title: skew3d
description:
If enabled, the axis title will skewed to follow the perspective.

This will fix overlapping labels and titles, but texts become
less legible due to the distortion.

The final appearance depends heavily on `title.position3d`.

A `null` value will use the config from `labels.skew3d`.

name: zAxis-title-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the title. If the title text is longer than the
axis length, it will wrap to multiple lines by default. This can
be customized by setting the `lineClamp` property, by setting a
specific `width` or by setting `whiteSpace: 'nowrap'`.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-axis-title` class.

name: zAxis-title-text
title: text
description:
The actual text of the axis title. It can contain basic HTML tags
like `b`, `i` and `span` with style.

name: zAxis-title-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
Alignment of the text, can be `"left"`, `"right"` or `"center"`.
Default alignment depends on the
[title.align](xAxis.title.align):

Horizontal axes:
- for `align` = `"low"`, `textAlign` is set to `left`
- for `align` = `"middle"`, `textAlign` is set to `center`
- for `align` = `"high"`, `textAlign` is set to `right`

Vertical axes:
- for `align` = `"low"` and `opposite` = `true`, `textAlign` is
  set to `right`
- for `align` = `"low"` and `opposite` = `false`, `textAlign` is
  set to `left`
- for `align` = `"middle"`, `textAlign` is set to `center`
- for `align` = `"high"` and `opposite` = `true` `textAlign` is
  set to `left`
- for `align` = `"high"` and `opposite` = `false` `textAlign` is
  set to `right`

name: zAxis-title-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the axis title.

name: zAxis-title-x
title: x
description: Horizontal pixel offset of the title position.

name: zAxis-title-y
title: y
description: Vertical pixel offset of the title position.

name: zAxis-type
title: type
description:
The type of axis. Can be one of `linear`, `logarithmic`, `datetime`
or `category`. In a datetime axis, the numbers are given in
milliseconds, and tick marks are placed on appropriate values like
full hours or days. In a category axis, the
[point names](#series.line.data.name) of the chart's series are used
for categories, if not a [categories](#xAxis.categories) array is
defined.

name: zAxis-uniqueNames
title: uniqueNames
description:
Applies only when the axis `type` is `category`. When `uniqueNames`
is true, points are placed on the X axis according to their names.
If the same point name is repeated in the same or another series,
the point is placed on the same X position as other points of the
same name. When `uniqueNames` is false, the points are laid out in
increasing X positions regardless of their names, and the X axis
category will take the name of the last point in each position.

name: zAxis-units
title: units
description:
Datetime axis only. An array determining what time intervals the
ticks are allowed to fall on. Each array item is an array where the
first value is the time unit and the second value another array of
allowed multiples.

Defaults to:
```js
units: [[
    'millisecond', // unit name
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500] // allowed multiples
], [
    'second',
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
], [
    'minute',
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
], [
    'hour',
    [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12]
], [
    'day',
    [1, 2]
], [
    'week',
    [1, 2]
], [
    'month',
    [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
], [
    'year',
    null
]]
```

name: zAxis-visible
title: visible
description:
Whether axis, including axis title, line, ticks and labels, should
be visible.

name: zAxis-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index for the axis group.

name: zAxis-zoomEnabled
title: zoomEnabled
description:
Whether to zoom axis. If `chart.zoomType` is set, the option allows
to disable zooming on an individual axis.
